styles.name_zh: Restaurant Brand Visual System Mockup风格
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 生成一张[餐饮品牌触点矩阵]系列视觉图，用于展示一个完整的餐饮品牌视觉系统与包装应用方案。

这是一个面向餐饮行业的品牌VI样机展示板 / 包装系统陈列图 / 品牌提案页。画面不是单张宣传海报，而是将品牌主视觉、主打产品、包装物料、菜单信息、促销内容与小型延展物料整合成一张系统化品牌展示图。

【用户输入信息】
- 品牌名：[品牌名]
- 经营类目：[经营类目]

【可选补充信息】
- 主打产品：[主打产品]
- 品牌口号：[品牌口号]
- 风格方向：[风格方向]
- 主色调：[主色调]
- 辅助色：[辅助色]
- 客群定位：[客群定位]
- 价格定位：[价格定位]
- 地域风格：[地域风格]
- 画幅比例：[画幅比例]

【自动补全规则】
如果用户没有提供完整品牌信息，请根据【品牌名】与【经营类目】自动推导并完成最优组合，包括：
1. 判断品牌调性（年轻、亲和、国潮、复古、清新、治愈、精致、快餐感等）
2. 匹配适合该类目的视觉风格
3. 自动设定合理的主色、辅助色与点缀色
4. 自动补全主打产品与辅助产品
5. 自动生成适合餐饮传播的品牌口号、卖点文案、价格信息与推荐标签
6. 自动匹配合适的餐饮物料类型与展示内容

【画面内容要求】
画面中应围绕【品牌名】构建一整套餐饮品牌物料系统，包含但不限于以下内容：
- 核心包装：手提袋、外卖袋、包装盒、打包盒、纸袋、塑料袋
- 饮品 / 食品容器：纸杯、杯套、碗、餐盒、封口贴、标签
- 信息传播物料：菜单、促销海报、价格牌、桌牌、立牌、小卡片
- 小型品牌延展：贴纸、徽章、纸巾、餐具、包装封条、吊牌
- 产品表现：主打餐品照片、单品主视觉、食物特写、切面图、推荐组合图

【构图与版式要求】
采用竖版【画幅比例】构图，整体为白色、米白色或浅灰色背景，以品牌提案板 / 样机矩阵板的方式组织画面。
通过大中小物料混排形成视觉层级：
- 大型包装和主视觉物料作为视觉锚点
- 中型菜单、海报和价格模块负责信息传达
- 小型贴纸、餐具、标签与周边物料增强系统完整度

整体构图应具有明确秩序感，接近品牌方案展示页、作品集陈列页、包装提案页的视觉效果。元素要排列整齐但不呆板，丰富但不杂乱，具有模块化与可阅读性。

【风格与质感要求】
整体风格应符合【经营类目】与【品牌名】气质，具有明显的餐饮品牌感、商业传播感、样机展示感与系统设计感。
可融合以下风格倾向：现代简洁、国潮趣味、轻复古、生活方式感、快消感、温暖治愈感、年轻化传播感。
材质真实，包含纸张、塑料、布袋、包装盒、杯体、贴纸、餐具等真实物料质感；光影柔和统一，像在干净摄影棚环境中拍摄的品牌物料合集。

【文字与图形要求】
所有物料上应统一出现品牌名、Logo、品牌符号、主色块、口号或卖点文案。
文案可为中文或中英混排，但要符合餐饮传播表达，简洁直接，具备商品售卖感。
图形系统可以根据品牌调性选择简洁插画、几何图形、卡通吉祥物、符号化图标或辅助纹样，用于增强品牌记忆点。

【输出目标】
最终生成一张完整的【品牌名】餐饮品牌视觉系统展示图，像设计团队为该餐饮品牌制作的整套品牌提案样机板。
要求画面统一、精致、具备商业落地感与作品集展示质量，并能清楚体现品牌风格、主打类目与多触点包装延展能力。

Make the aspect ratio 9:16

styles.id: neo-case14-视觉设计规格描述画幅比-916竖版手机信息图
styles.name_en: 视觉设计规格描述：画幅比 9:16（竖版手机信息图...
styles.prompt: {prompt}, 视觉设计规格描述：画幅比 9:16（竖版手机信息图）；背景纹理为具有呼吸感的米色手工纸（Handmade Washi Paper），带微小纤维纹理，边角有轻微水渍晕染；配色方案为熟番茄红（#E23A28）、初榨橄榄油金黄（#F2C94C）、嫩草绿（#6FCF97）、碳黑墨线；排版逻辑为顶端大标题、中间 Z 字形流线、底部全景成品、留白艺术化处理。食谱内容策划：1）顶部标题《番茄炒蛋：国民灵魂料理》，手绘书法体，侧边盖红色“厨师推荐”微型印章。2）步骤区块（Z 动线排版）：步骤1 挑选与备菜（左上）：三个番茄、四枚土鸡蛋、一簇葱花；说明：番茄切小块，鸡蛋打散均匀；厨师秘技：番茄去皮后切块，汁水更浓郁，口感更丝滑；心得：选熟透番茄，成功一半。步骤2 蛋液的魔法（右上）：手持筷子快速搅动蛋液，泛起气泡与动感线；说明：加少许盐和几滴温水；厨师秘技：加温水或白醋，鸡蛋更蓬松；心得：搅打充分，空气是蓬松秘密。步骤3 烈火蓬松蛋（左中）：铁锅中蛋液迅速膨胀如云朵，水彩表现热气；说明：油热下锅，快速划散，八成熟盛出；厨师秘技：油温高，烟起即入，瞬间锁水；心得：宁可稍嫩，不可过老。步骤4 番茄出浓汁（右中）：番茄翻滚，边缘半融化，亮红汤汁流淌；说明：煸炒至出汁，加少许糖和盐；厨师秘技：铲子轻压加速出汁，可加一勺番茄酱提色；心得：糖中和酸度、提鲜。步骤5 最后的合奏（左下）：鸡蛋回锅与番茄汁交织，撒葱花；说明：让鸡蛋吸饱番茄汁，关火装盘；厨师秘技：出锅前滴几滴芝麻油提香；心得：动作要快，保持鲜亮色泽。3）底部成品插图：青花边陶瓷深盘装满番茄炒蛋，红亮汁水包裹金黄大块鸡蛋，葱花点缀，水彩渲染半透明酱汁质感，边缘有袅袅热气；视觉感：看了就想立刻盛一碗大米饭。4）底部中央署名：[ 摄影师的厨房日记 · 2025 ]。

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 请生成一张中文健身信息图，主题为：【xxx】。

要求这张图既专业又实用，适合普通成年人作为训练参考。默认对象为无严重伤病的健康成年人；如果没有额外说明，默认训练目标为“增肌 + 基础力量提升”，默认训练水平为“新手到中级之间”，默认训练场景为“普通健身房”，默认单次训练时长控制在 40–60 分钟内。

请根据【训练主题】自动判断输出类型：

1）如果【训练主题】是某个肌群或身体部位（例如：胸肌、背阔肌、肱二头肌、腹肌、肩部、腿部等），请输出一张“该部位训练计划信息图”。
2）如果【训练主题】是某个动作或技能目标（例如：引体向上、俯卧撑、双杠臂屈伸、深蹲等），请输出一张“动作解锁 / 进阶训练计划信息图”。

整张图请采用清晰、现代、专业、易读的中文信息图风格，竖版排版，视觉简洁，重点突出，适合社交媒体分享或训练参考卡片。不要写成长篇大论，每个模块用简洁短句呈现，数字信息要醒目。

这张信息图必须包含以下内容：

【A. 标题区】
- 主标题：直接写【训练主题】训练计划 / 解锁计划
- 副标题：自动补充适用人群、目标、训练场景、建议时长
例如：适合新手 / 增肌导向 / 健身房版 / 45分钟

【B. 训练目标区】
用简洁语言说明：
- 这次训练主要针对什么
- 主要目标是什么（增肌 / 力量 / 技能解锁 / 核心控制等）
- 本次训练的重点刺激或能力提升方向

【C. 热身区】
给出 2–4 个热身建议，简洁列出即可，例如：
- 动态活动
- 目标肌群激活
- 轻重量预热组
每项可附一句说明

【D. 主训练区】
这是核心部分，请列出 4–6 个主要训练动作。
每个动作都要包含以下信息：
- 动作名称
- 训练作用 / 针对部位
- 组数 × 次数（或时间）
- RIR 建议
- 每组间休息时间
- 动作关键要点（1–2 条）
- 常见错误（1 条即可）

请确保动作安排合理：
- 先复合动作，后孤立动作
- 整体训练量适中
- 新手不要安排过度极限训练
- 主动作通常建议 RIR 1–3
- 孤立动作可建议 RIR 0–2
- 如果是腹肌或核心类动作，可用“秒数 / 次数”形式
- 如果是技能类动作，请优先安排“前置能力动作 + 过渡动作 + 目标动作尝试”

【E. 进阶 / 解锁逻辑区】
根据主题自动生成：
- 如果是肌群训练：写“如何渐进超负荷”，例如达到次数上限后再加重量、优先保证动作标准等
- 如果是动作解锁：写“分阶段进阶路径”，例如从悬垂、肩胛引体、离心训练、弹力带辅助，到标准动作完成

【F. 替代动作区】
请给出 2–3 个替代动作，适用于以下情况：
- 没有器械
- 家庭训练
- 当前能力不足
- 某些动作做不了

【G. 执行提醒区】
请给出 4–6 条简洁提醒，例如：
- 动作标准优先于重量
- 不要每组都练到力竭
- 同肌群建议间隔 48–72 小时
- 疼痛不等于正常发力
- 睡眠不足时可适当减少训练量

【H. 恢复建议区】
简洁说明：
- 训练后恢复重点
- 蛋白质 / 睡眠 / 恢复间隔建议
- 1 句风险提醒（如有明显疼痛应停止并评估）

【I. 视觉设计要求】
- 整体为单页中文信息图
- 竖版排版
- 风格现代、清爽、专业、健身感强
- 使用模块化卡片布局
- 重点数字（组数、次数、RIR、休息）要醒目
- 可加入简洁的人体肌群图标、哑铃、杠铃、引体向上等小图标
- 颜色保持高级、干净、有运动感
- 中文文字必须清晰、准确、易读
- 避免过多装饰，强调实用性与执行性

请最终输出为“一张完整的信息图内容”，而不是只给普通段落文字。

A second small Finder window with image thumbnails is partly visible behind it. Make it feel like an accidental real phone photo of a working laptop screen. No real-person likeness, no beauty filter, no perfect UI, no screenshot, no watermark, no cartoon, no 3D render.

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 通用提示词：

生成一张【超宽连续背景场景长图】，单张完整图片，不要拼图，不要多宫格，不要分栏，横版 3:1。

场景类型：【都市沿街店铺 / 雨夜霓虹街区 / 县城小镇店面 / 乡村街巷立面】
时间氛围：【白天 / 午后 / 雨夜 / 夜景】
主要内容：【填写店铺或建筑类型】
画面气质：【真实 / 连续 / 生活化 / 实用】

画面采用平视、正面视角，重点表现一整排连续展开的店面或建筑立面。不要斜拍，不要强透视，不要广角畸变，不要街道往远处消失，而是像一张平面化、正对面展开的连续立面长图。

每个店面或建筑单元都要正面完整可见，门头、招牌、橱窗、门窗、入口、卷帘门、院墙、门前物件清晰可见。可以加入少量路灯、树木、自行车、电动车、三轮车、长椅、杂物等环境元素，以及极少量小人物点缀，但重点始终是连续背景本身。

整体效果像短剧背景板、场景搭建参考图、连续环境设定长卷，突出“超宽横图一次性容纳完整空间信息”的优势。

避免斜拍、强透视、拼图感、多宫格、人物过多、海报感、卡通感、低清晰度、额外大字标题。

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, prompt

生成一张 9:16 竖版高级海报，主题为「端午」，整体风格为现代东方禅意美学。首先必须先核实当前真实日期与当前年份端午节的真实时间节点，判断现在是端午前夕、端午当天还是刚过端午，并据此决定画面情绪、文案语气与日期展示，绝对不要使用错误时间。整张海报不是传统节日海报，不要粽子、卡通龙舟、红金喜庆、祥云边框、节日模板或电商促销感。它必须像一张安静、年轻、克制、带呼吸感的现代东方情绪海报，具有禅意、留白感、夏日气息和高级设计秩序。画面可出现一位年轻亚洲女性作为情绪载体，背影、侧身或低头，穿着白色、米白、浅灰、淡青绿色的轻薄亚麻夏装，站在白墙、窗边、露台或带现代东方气息的简静空间中，微风轻轻吹动她的头发和衣角。场景要有柔和自然光、水面反光、水波投影、白色纱帘、修长植物、石木布纸等自然材质，整体安静、空、净、缓。端午元素必须被隐性转译：艾草与菖蒲变成修长克制的植物线条，水以反光和流动光影的方式呈现，龙舟只留下秩序线条、轻微重复节奏与前行方向感，粽叶转化为叶片折叠感与布料包裹感，但不要直接画粽子。色彩以雾白、米白、浅灰白、鼠尾草绿、苔绿色、水光蓝灰、少量浅墨色为主，极少量淡金色点缀。质感要有柔和自然光、轻微胶片颗粒、微雾感、纸张印刷感、轻景深，避免明显 AI 塑料感。排版必须高度专业：清晰三级层级，主标题最大、副标题中等、说明文字最小，比例约为 100 / 40 / 15；优先使用左对齐，建立统一隐形对齐线；通过大小、粗细、字距、字体形成对比；留白至少 40%，文字面积不超过画面 10%；主标题不超过两行，只强调一个核心词；文字要有节奏感，可拆行形成短长短的呼吸；整张海报必须有一个唯一视觉锚点；英文辅助文字适度拉开字距；整体行距偏松，带呼吸感；建立网格系统后再排版。字体不要描边，不要发光，不要阴影，最多使用两种字重。建议文案：主标题「端午」或「夏自此深」；副标题「把夏天，过得慢一点」或「端午，是夏天留给人的一口气」；英文辅助可用「SLOW INTO SUMMER」或「A QUIET MOMENT OF DUANWU」。整体效果要像一张年轻人第一眼就会喜欢、愿意保存的禅意端午海报。 同时生成 6 张！

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 极简萌系Logo提示词：

生成一个《极简萌系符号》风格的品牌 Logo，品牌名为【品牌名】，品类为【品类】。以【主体形象】为核心视觉，把主体画成简洁、可爱、松弛、带一点小情绪的极简符号形象。

整体采用极少元素、圆润线条、几何化外轮廓、平面矢量感、轻微手写感，造型简洁但要有辨识度，不要复杂插画，不要写实，不要3D，不要厚重质感。配色以【主色】为主，可搭配1-2个低饱和辅助色，颜色干净柔和。

Logo 由“图形符号 + 中文字标 / 可少量搭配英文副标”组成，文字部分要自然、有设计感、不过度花哨，整体排版简洁舒服，留白充足，背景纯白或浅灰白。

画面要像一个完整品牌 Logo 提案，风格轻松、治愈、现代、可商用，适合咖啡、家居、杂货、甜品、生活方式品牌。不要复杂背景，不要多余装饰，不要海报感，不要一整页版式，只保留一个完整 Logo 方案。

可替换字段参考：
【品牌名】小蓝蛙咖啡 / 眠兔袋袋 / 山气家居 / 春杯小熊
【品类】咖啡品牌 / 包袋杂货 / 家居品牌 / 甜品品牌
【主体形象】小蓝蛙 / 睡眠感小兔 / 山形与空气感符号 / 小熊与杯子
【主色】雾蓝 / 奶油黄 / 苔藓绿 / 焦糖棕

{prompt}, A breathtaking and extremely complex world-building infographic masterpiece conceptualizing the "Fundamental Differences between Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism", designed as a profound ancient Oriental mythological manuscript.
Background: Pure white vintage textured canvas with a light beige aged parchment base color, subtle frayed edges, and water stain textures.
Core Layout: Central vision uses a grand "vertical egg-shaped layered structure", with Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism layers from top to bottom.
Margins: Four corners are decorated with fine micro-illustrations featuring ancient observation notes, ritual implements, and runes.
Colors: Low-saturation sage green, light gold, and off-white as main tones; overall light and soft without harsh high-saturation colors.
Details: Architectural lines, landscape brushwork, lotus patterns, and cloud layers are clearly visible and exquisitely detailed.
Seamless Fusion: The three layers transition naturally through clouds and flowing water; the Buddhist halo, Taoist Taiji mist, and Confucian scholarly aura connect seamlessly.
Style: Classical ink line art + low-saturation digital watercolor, with a light Chinese-style ancient book manuscript texture.
Text Annotations: Authentic Traditional Chinese characters in a mottled vintage Song typeface. Each annotation includes a short title + a line of poetic description, connected to corresponding details by dark gold hair-thin lines with no overlapping pointers.
Aspect Ratio: 3:4 vertical format, independent and complete.

Title Area (Top): `儒釋道·根本區別` (Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism: Fundamental Differences)
Central Layer Labels:
Top "Buddhism": `釋`, `Relationship between man and self`, `Selflessness, governing the heart, letting go`

Side Annotations:
Left: `Purity`: pure heart and clear mind, cutting off troubles; `Stillness`: following nature, returning to the original heart; `Respect`: respecting responsibility, active involvement in society.
Right: `60+ Spiritual Cultivation`: looking lightly at gain/loss; `35-55 Conduct`: living with flexibility, following laws; `7-35 Actions`: forging ahead, building careers.

- A clear and beautiful main visual of the subject
- Several magnified details of local characteristics
- Multiple rounded modular information sections
- Clear title hierarchies and key labels
- Concise yet rich encyclopedic content
- Visual ratings, key point summaries, or Top 5 modules

Content columns should be automatically adapted based on the theme, prioritized from these directions: basic profile, classification information, appearance characteristics, habits/ecology, formation mechanism/structure, growth or use conditions, care or maintenance suggestions, risks and precautions, suitable audience or scenarios, pros and cons comparison, and quick rating cards.

Visual requirements:
Light-colored clean background, soft color palette, light shadows, exquisite small icons, rounded information boxes, neat layout, high information density but not crowded, good reading experience. The overall result must look like a real science encyclopedia card suitable for publishing, reading, collecting, and serialized production, rather than an advertisement.

Please do not make it a regular commercial promotional poster. Highlight the features of "knowledge organization + modular information + illustration-style display."

styles.prompt: {prompt}, [MEDIUM] Masterclass, award-winning landscape photography. Shot with a medium-format Hasselblad and an 85mm medium-telephoto lens to compress the background and amplify forest density. The image utilizes advanced Focus Stacking for mathematically impossible, crystalline edge-to-edge sharpness from the closest rock to the furthest tree. The subtle application of the Orton Effect gives a magical, ethereal glow to the highlights, while a circular polarizer eliminates all glare from the wet surfaces. [SETTING] A forgotten, ancient woodland path winding along a steep ridge in Lindórinand (the Vales of Anduin) during the Second Age of Middle-earth. The towering canopy consists of colossal, silver-barked ancient European Beeches and dark oaks. The ground is thickly carpeted in a breathtaking, fiery mosaic of wet, russet, copper, and burnt-sienna fallen leaves. [EVENT MODIFIERS] The composition features a natural, rugged leading line. An uneven, organically winding game-trail meanders roughly from the bottom right, curving imperfectly around massive tree roots before vanishing into heavy, cool cyan-tinted river mist in the deep background. Massive, jagged boulders of mica-flecked schist, slick with moisture and draped in vibrant emerald star-moss, act as heavy visual anchor points framing the left side of the trail. Above, overarching branches with late-autumn foliage interlock to create a natural, unmanicured vignette, a rugged frame-within-a-frame that funnels the viewer's eye downward. Exactly at the vanishing point of the meandering trail, where the heavy mist is thickest, the majestic silhouette of a massive, dark-antlered Red Deer stag is half-swallowed by the fog. Its form fades seamlessly into the cool cyan atmosphere, standing silently on the path and capturing the wild, untamed magic of the world before the preservation of the Elven Rings.

They are holding a soaked daily newspaper over their heads as a makeshift umbrella to block the freezing rain. [EVENT MODIFIERS] The tiny figures are looking up in awe and terror at the looming gothic structure in the distance. The torrential rain bounces off the newspaper and the muddy ground. styles.name_en: C4D风格海报烤鱼立体门店促销海报设计
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 3d电影感,C4D风格,仰视角度,超大广角,超大透视,夸张视觉表现,广角镜头,美团 × 半天妖烤鱼
画面聚焦一座橙棕配色的半天妖烤鱼立体门店，门店醒目展示 “半天妖烤鱼” 标识，内部陈列着清江鱼、湄公鱼等鱼模型，旁边摆放着青花椒、香辣、蒜香等不同口味的调料罐，满满都是烤鱼的鲜香气息。门店顶部堆叠着巨型烤盘，里面躺着裹满酱汁的仿真烤鱼，搭配金针菇、豆腐等配菜，宛如一座 “焦香烤鱼塔”。
城市背景里，傍晚的天空泛着淡紫霞光。创意元素极具巧思：青花椒造型的绿色热气球、红色辣椒造型的热气球，与黄色美团兔子热气球一同悬浮在空中；白色金针菇、嫩黄色豆腐块造型的气球围绕着门店，透着诱人的烟火气。
画面下方，美团黄色兔子 IP 正提着印双品牌标识的防漏烤鱼打包盒，脚边的黄色配送车旁还放着几份米饭套餐。场景搭配 “点半天妖烤鱼 上美团外卖 最快 30 分钟送达” 的标语，加上 “招牌烤鱼 配菜免费加” 的促销信息，营造出便捷解馋的用餐氛围。

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 竖版雪糕夏日电商海报，元气热闹夏日风，鲜亮澄澈蓝天背景，漂浮蓬松白云，画面四周点缀盛放的白色花朵与鲜绿叶片，底部有飞溅涌动的奶白色牛奶波纹，氛围感清凉鲜活；画面中心错落摆放多款不同包装、口味的脆皮棒冰，外包装色彩丰富：棕调经典款、抹茶绿款、白色白巧款、深棕生巧款、黄色香蕉牛奶款、粉色草莓酸奶款，部分雪糕拆开包装露出带着脆粒的酥脆外皮，雪糕内馅层次分明，巧克力、草莓果肉等馅料细节逼真，排布富有前后层次感。
详细字体 & 文案排版细节
海报顶部：超大立体加粗白字、蓝色外描边的主标题「味蕾大爆炸」；标题下方排布横幅文案，两侧黄色条幅分别写「冰常夏日」「冰爽来袭」，中间蓝色小字写「夏日新品 冰爽上市」，更下方小字标语「这个夏天・从一支 开始」；
画面左右分散排布多个半透明圆形气泡标签，左侧气泡文案从上至下：「冰镇爽口」「真材实料」；右侧气泡依次排布：「多种口味」「随心选择」「丝滑香浓」；
海报底部分左右文案区块，左侧蓝粉配色手写字体「一口冰爽 ❤快乐加倍」，右侧字体搭配小太阳装饰写「夏日治愈系 降温小确幸」；
 字体细节：顶部大标题是厚重立体卡通黑体，横幅文字采用醒目规整无衬线黑体；圆形气泡内字体圆润适中；底部标语采用活泼手写风字体；雪糕外包装印刷适配清新的卡通印刷字体；整体文字配色适配蓝天背景，层级清晰醒目；采用明亮自然光，雪糕脆皮细碎坚果颗粒清晰，巧克力光泽自然，整体色彩明艳饱满，浅景深虚化背景云朵花草突出雪糕主体，8K 超清画质，高质量食品商业海报实拍质感，竖版采用 3:4 构图
负面提示词（粘贴进负面输入框规避问题）
雪糕外形扭曲、脆皮开裂怪异，内馅质感浑浊违和，外包装褶皱变形、包装印刷文字乱码错乱，花瓣叶片干枯难看，牛奶飞溅浑浊脏污，气泡标签轮廓粗糙、字体毛刺歪斜、排版拥挤错乱，多余水印、路人、无关杂物闯入画面，天空色调暗沉灰蒙蒙，阴影厚重生硬，整体色彩饱和度超标刺眼，画面噪点偏高模糊发糊，突兀硬质边框、夸张廉价滤镜，坚果碎分布杂乱违和

styles.name_en: Je Sens「Camellia 山茶花」香水系列视觉海报，柔美朦胧风格融合自然花卉美学，采用中心聚焦式构图，背景为柔雾感粉调渐变
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Je Sens「Camellia 山茶花」香水系列视觉海报，柔美朦胧风格融合自然花卉美学，采用中心聚焦式构图，背景为柔雾感粉调渐变。

画面核心呈现香氛系列产品与氛围布景：

• 核心产品：透明瓶身配深棕瓶盖的主调香水、渐变瓶身的「Camellia」香氛，搭配印有“Je Sens”与多花材名称的礼盒，传递“EXPLORE AUTHENTICITY AND NATURE”的品牌理念。

• 氛围元素：悬停的浅粉茶壶、散落的白色山茶花、郁金香与粉色红掌，营造“山茶花”主题的柔雾浪漫氛围，强化花香调的产品属性。

主色调为柔粉、米白、裸色，辅以朦胧光影的层次变化，字体采用纤细优雅的衬线字体，图形以山茶花与朦胧花卉意象为核心视觉符号。整体呈现温柔高级的花香调香水品牌氛围，适配高端香氛产品传播与电商展示

styles.name_zh: 超写实东方奇幻｜尘锁古龛·尘𩂋
styles.name_en: 超写实东方奇幻｜尘锁古龛·尘𩂋
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 超写实东方奇幻｜尘锁古龛·尘𩂋

超写实东方奇幻风格，保留东方留白构图，电影级真实光影与物理肌理，完全原创无传统物种原型。

远景古龛隐在灰雾中，供桌倾塌，香火残烬，天色微白留白；中景残碑、断香、灰土、旧幔与碎瓦层层堆积，风卷尘粒穿过龛门；近景原创异兽「尘𩂋」伏在龛前，体态松散沉重，打破常规生物结构。

无兽首、无鳞甲、无羽翼，主体由尘粒空腔、泥纹骨络与灰絮软组织构成，像从古龛尘封中长出的灰蒙生命。躯体呈不规则尘团状，表面有干裂纹、泥痕、香灰沉积与细密尘粒；核心是一枚灰白尘瞳，缓慢明灭，神态迷蒙、久远、压迫感强。

尘雾绕体缓慢升腾，微光穿过龛隙投下灰影，氛围尘封、将醒、神秘。东方留白构图与超写实材质结合，物种形态独创。

OC渲染，8K极致细节，香灰、残碑、旧幔、尘粒质感真实立体，画面纵深强。

右下角超低透微光点缀：半透明斑驳楚篆印章【星火华夏】，柔光小字“浮生若梦2026”，低调隐形点缀，不干扰主体画面氛围。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 16:9 横构图，户外硬核风格折叠电动自行车产品海报。画面主体：一辆黑色 + 荧光绿配色的折叠式胖胎电动自行车，停放在崎岖的山地碎石路面上，车身微微侧向镜头呈 3/4 角度展示。车辆细节：宽大的越野胖胎（黑色深纹防滑花纹）、折叠车架为哑光黑色金属管材、车把和座椅为黑色、车架关节和装饰条为荧光绿 / 亮绿色点缀、前后碟刹清晰可见、后货架为黑色金属材质。车辆前叉和后避震部位各有一处发光的青蓝色 / 电光蓝色光效高亮，模拟悬挂系统的科技感视觉强调，光芒向外柔和扩散。车身两侧各有一个青蓝色发光标注气泡框，左侧标注 "Adaptive Fork" 指向前避震叉，右侧标注 "Progressive Linkage" 指向后避震连杆，标注框为圆角矩形半透明深色底 + 青蓝色边框 + 白色文字。背景：雄伟的灰黑色雪山山脉，山峰被浓云笼罩，整体氛围阴沉壮阔，天空为深灰蓝色压低的乌云层，营造极限户外探险感。地面为灰色碎石 + 浅水洼反光质感。画面顶部居中大号标题文字 "TOTAL SHOCK SYSTEM"（白色粗体无衬线全大写字体，字号醒目），标题下方一行副标题小字 "Advanced dual-dampening technology absorbs 95% of impact force, delivering unmatched stability on the roughest trails."（白色常规字重无衬线体）。画面底部横向排列三组功能卖点图标 + 文字：左侧山峰轮廓图标 +"TRACTION — Confident grip on any surface."；中间波浪线图标 +"SMOOTH RIDE — Reduced vibration, zero fatigue."；右侧方向盘图标 +"PRECISION — Responsive handling at all speeds."（均为白色小号无衬线字体，图标为线性简笔风格）。整体色调：暗调为主，黑灰蓝色系背景，产品以黑色 + 荧光绿为主色，青蓝色光效作为科技感点缀色，白色文字高对比突出。光线：自然阴天环境光，整体偏暗低调，产品上有来自正面偏上的柔和照明确保车体细节清晰，青蓝色光效为后期合成效果。整体风格：户外运动装备广告大片感，硬朗、专业、科技感兼具

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 16:9 横构图，高端无线头戴式耳机产品广告海报。纯黑色 / 深炭灰色背景，整体色调为低明度的黑灰色系，营造静谧高奢的极简科技感氛围。画面中央偏右放置一副纯白色头戴式耳机，耳机头梁为白色编织网面材质，耳罩为哑光陶瓷白 / 珍珠白色金属质感外壳，耳垫为浅灰白色透气网布。耳机以微微倾斜的 3/4 侧面角度悬浮展示，头梁朝上呈佩戴姿态。耳机背后有一层柔和的银白色辉光 / 光晕向外扩散，增加产品的悬浮感和聚焦效果。耳机后方叠加超大号半透明深灰色立体字 "VERSE" 作为背景装饰文字，字体为粗黑体 / 无衬线加粗，带有轻微的玻璃拟态质感和模糊效果。耳机左侧叠加一个毛玻璃效果的圆角矩形音乐播放器 UI 界面卡片 —— 深色半透明玻璃质感，内含专辑封面缩略图、歌曲名 "Velvet Horizon"、艺术家名 "LYRA"、播放进度条（白色细线 + 圆点指示器）、播放 / 前进 / 后退按钮图标（白色）。画面顶部居中位置印有品牌名 "Dreamina"（白色细体无衬线字体）和产品系列名 "ARC"（白色粗体大号无衬线字体），系列名下方为型号名 "ZENITH"（超大号半透明发光字，带有白色辉光描边效果）。画面底部横向排列三个功能图标 + 说明文字：电池图标 +"60H ENDURANCE"、降噪波形图标 +"ADAPTIVE SILENCE"、音频波形图标 +"IMMERSIVE DEPTH"，均为浅灰白色小号无衬线字体。最底部居中一行小字 "ENGINEERED BY DREAMINA LABS" 配品牌小图标。整体设计风格：苹果式极简科技美学，毛玻璃拟态 UI 元素融合产品实物，纯黑背景衬托白色产品形成强烈明暗对比，光效克制仅用于聚焦产品。光线：产品本身有来自正面偏上的柔和冷调环境光照明，白色金属外壳呈现细腻的珠光反射质感，边缘有微妙的轮廓光勾勒产品线条，背景辉光为后期合成效果。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 一张C4D商业渲染风格的3D视觉图，深蓝色背景（深邃沉稳的深海蓝，带有细腻的渐变层次），方便后期抠图或合成。主题为“9月旗舰手机扎堆上新”。画面中央偏右是一组错落排列的智能手机——3部不同颜色的手机呈弧形陈列，每部手机均以侧立或微仰角度展示，屏幕采用深邃的黑色镜面质感，表面带有细腻的高光反射和环境光映照，模拟高级数码产品的熄屏美学，机身颜色分别为：淡金色、暖白色、浅橙色。手机之间有一道极细的金色光带蜿蜒穿过，将三者串联起来，象征“新品接连发布”的节奏感。手机周围悬浮着几个极简的几何符号：一枚发光的淡金色圆环（环绕其中一部手机）、一枚微小的金色向上箭头（浮在画面右侧）、以及几颗细小的金色光点（散落点缀）。画面顶部有一束柔和的暖金色光线斜斜打下，聚焦于手机阵列的中心，光线在手机黑色屏幕上形成精致的高光反射，营造出“新品登场”的高级质感。所有元素为C4D真实渲染风格，造型简洁利落，光影细腻逼真，带有柔和漫反射和轻微镜面反射，无强烈阴影。整体色调以深蓝色为背景，搭配淡金、暖白、浅橙，形成冷暖对比，无任何绿色系。无文字、无字母、无数字。比例4:3。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 16:9 横构图，俯拍视角（约 60 度俯角）的机械键盘产品摄影。画面主体：一把 87 键 / TKL 布局的机械键盘居中偏左放置，键盘外壳为哑光深空黑色铝合金材质，键帽采用双色注塑工艺 —— 字母区和功能区为电光紫 / 霓虹紫色键帽，修饰键（Shift、Ctrl、Alt、Enter、空格键等）为深黑色键帽，ESC 键和方向键为荧光洋红 / 品红色点缀。键帽表面为哑光 PBT 材质，侧面可见双色注塑的黑色底层。键盘周围散落着数颗拆下的黑色和紫色备用键帽，以及一个金属拔键器。桌面场景：键盘放置在一张深灰色 / 炭黑色切割垫板上（表面带有白色细网格线刻度），切割垫下方为黑色桌面。键盘左上方放置一个复古风格的游戏手柄 —— 手柄外壳为黑色磨砂质感，按键为霓虹紫色和洋红色。画面右上角有一本深紫色封面的笔记本一角露出。桌面上还散布着几个黑色长尾夹、一把小型六角扳手等工具小物件，增加桌面生活感。** 画面左侧中间偏下的空白暗区，纵向排列数行白色小号无衬线英文标注文字（字号极小，类似技术规格标注风格），内容为："HOT-SWAPPABLE / GASKET MOUNT / 5-PIN RGB / PBT DOUBLE-SHOT / N-KEY ROLLOVER / 8000Hz POLLING"，每行一个参数，行间距紧凑，文字左对齐，字体为等宽 / 工业风细体，整体作为画面的设计排版元素融入构图，不破坏产品摄影的沉浸感。** 整体色调：以黑色为基底，电光紫 + 荧光洋红作为主题撞色，冷调、暗黑、赛博朋克感。光线：主光源为画面右上方的强方向性硬光，形成明显的从右上到左下的对角线光照方向，在键盘表面形成清晰的亮面 - 暗面分区。右上方键帽受光面呈现明亮的高光反射，左下方键帽逐渐过渡到阴影区域，形成强烈的明暗梯度。键盘在切割垫上投射出向左下方延伸的清晰硬边投影。切割垫的白色网格线在受光区域清晰可见，在阴影区域逐渐隐没。散落的键帽和小物件同样呈现一致的右上方光照方向，各自投射出方向统一的小型硬影。整体光比较大（约 3:1），明暗对比鲜明但过渡自然，不是完全剪影式的极端反差。画面四周有明显的暗角压暗效果（尤其左下角和右下角最深），形成中央亮、四周暗的聚光筒式氛围，将视觉焦点牢牢锁定在键盘主体区域。背景深黑色桌面吸收大部分光线，仅切割垫区域因白色网格反射而呈现中灰调子。整体风格：极客桌面美学产品摄影，暗黑系赛博朋克配色，干净利落的科技感与复古游戏文化交融。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 竖版极简抽象艺术海报，画面中心悬浮着一尊太湖石造型有机流体雕塑，整体呈连续扭曲的火焰形态，表面带有汝窑典型的天青釉色与温润哑光光泽，釉层肥厚，布满细密自然的冰裂纹理（开片），呈现出柔和的玉质感与陶土的深沉底蕴。雕塑由仿汝窑瓷材质构成，边缘过渡柔和，无明显锐利高光，光影层次细腻，强调釉色的温润与形体的微妙起伏，突出瓷土的浑厚体量感。背景为从上到下的浅灰到深灰柔和径向渐变，干净无噪点，无实体底平面，雕塑下方带有轻微的柔和投影，强化悬浮感。整体为现代极简抽象设计风格，色彩雅致柔和，质感温厚静谧，带有汝窑独有的含蓄光泽，类似当代平面艺术与陶瓷静物摄影的结合作品。

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Create a simple biology diagram titled "Cellular Respiration at a Glance" for high school students.

Show how glucose turns into energy inside a cell. Include glycolysis, the Krebs cycle, and the electron transport chain.
Use arrows to connect the steps, and label the main molecules: glucose, pyruvate, ATP, NADH, FADH2, CO2, O2, and H2O.
Make it look like a clean classroom handout or slide, with a white background, simple icons, clear labels, and easy-to-read text.

Avoid tiny text, extra decoration, or anything that makes the diagram hard to understand.

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Create one pitch-deck slide titled **"Market Opportunity"** that feels like a real Series A fundraising slide from a YC-backed startup.

Use a clean white background, modern sans-serif typography like Inter, and a crisp, minimal layout. The slide should include:

* A TAM/SAM/SOM concentric-circle diagram in muted blues and grays
* Specific, believable market sizing numbers:

  * **TAM:** $42B
  * **SAM:** $8.7B
  * **SOM:** $340M
* A clean bar chart below showing market growth from **2021 to 2026**, with a subtle upward trend
* Small footnotes: **"AGI Research, 2024"** and **"Internal analysis"**
* A company logo placeholder in the bottom-right corner

The design should look like it belongs in a deck that actually raised money: highly readable text, clear data hierarchy, polished spacing, and professional startup-style visual language.

Avoid clip art, stock photography, gradients, shadows, decorative elements, or anything that feels generic or overdesigned.

Composition: – The uploaded image should *inspire* the design but not appear as-is.   – Incorporate abstracted or illustrated motifs (e.g., landmarks, silhouettes, textures, or shapes referencing the photo).   – The composition should feel like a curated travel collectible — artistic, minimal, and stylish.   – Transparent background only — no backdrop or frame color.   – The stamp should be cleanly outlined with crisp perforations, suitable for overlay or compositing.   Technical: – Modern flat or semi-flat illustration style (no photorealistic collage).   – Balanced, centered 1:1 composition.   – High-resolution PNG with transparent background.   – Output should have a refined graphic design quality, like a trendy travel sticker or editorial stamp collection. styles.name_zh: Analyst Facing a Mountain of Postponed L
styles.name_en: Analyst Facing a Mountain of Postponed Letters
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, A minimalist nocturne in a wide frame: an endless matte teal void holds exactly two islands of meaning. At the right, a sleepless analyst in a gray sweater sits at a tiny drafting table under a single cone of warm lamplight, pen frozen over unsent letters. At the left looms a mountain of postponed paperwork: drifts of envelopes and unsent letters piled like snowdrifts, their edges catching the lamp spill. Between them, on the bare floor, one small crow watches the analyst.

The composition is mostly deliberate emptiness: flat teal darkness above and between, the lamp cone the only warm geometry. Paper edges, sweater knit and crow feathers carry the only texture. Quiet, droll, melancholy. Rendered as a realistic cinematic wide photograph, sharp on desk and drifts, the void perfectly smooth.

styles.name_zh: Ancient Sword Bridges a Canyon of Pages风
styles.name_en: Ancient Sword Bridges a Canyon of Pages
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, An enormous open antique book becomes a miniature canyon, its two thick page blocks carefully carved into terraced ivory cliffs descending toward the deep central gutter. Across the canyon lies one ornate medieval sword as a bridge: its dark steel blade runs from the lower-left page bank diagonally to the upper-right bank, the near side supporting the heavy black leather grip and engraved aged-gold crossguard, the far bank supporting the broad blade near its point. Both support contacts are visible. The sword has a continuous straight blade and convincing weight; its central fuller catches one narrow line of warm light.

The book’s sculpted page edges form flowing geological contours, with a slender reflective gold ribbon resembling a river along the bottom of the gutter. A tiny empty staircase is cut into one paper cliff and leads toward the sword’s near landing. The exposed page surfaces are blank weathered ivory, emphasizing paper grain and layered edges. The dark leather book cover is clearly visible beneath both banks, anchoring the miniature illusion as a crafted object on a stone tabletop.

Use a wide 16:9 cinematic macro photograph from a low oblique three-quarter angle, requested canvas 2048 by 1152 pixels. Fit the entire sword, both landings and the open book inside the frame. Warm side light rakes across the embossed gold crossguard, rough dark steel, thin paper layers and deep canyon shadows. The carved cliffs and sword are sharply resolved; the distant tabletop fades into soft charcoal darkness, with a few restrained warm dust motes.

Compose the complete can, hand grip, stream and flower as an elegant descending diagonal with generous lateral separation, sharp product edges and a softly graded blue background. styles.name_zh: Cub Sending Off a Paper Boat风格
styles.name_en: Cub Sending Off a Paper Boat
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, A photorealistic studio photograph of a gouache children's-book illustration presented as one irregularly shaped scene slice, centered on a perfectly flat, evenly lit matte pale-blush surface with no texture and no grain, uniform in tone to every edge. The slice holds one small complete scene: a round, fuzzy bear cub crouched at the edge of a narrow spring stream, having just released a bright red paper boat that now rides the water away, leaving a soft trail of ripples. The painting uses soft rounded gouache shapes with gentle grain and visible brush texture, layered washes of muted spring green and warm brown building easy depth, the cub's face simple and expressive with a hopeful look. styles.prompt: {prompt}, { "title": "{argument name=\"title\" default=\"冬日暮色中的灯笼\"}", "scene": "暮色中宁静的冬日森林。柔和的雪花从天空中轻轻飘落，周围的树木隐没在梦幻般的蓝色冬日雾气中。", "subject": "{argument name=\"subject\" default=\"一位年轻女性独自站在飘落的雪花下，身穿一件米色长款羊毛大衣，围着厚实的针织围巾。她神情平静安详，将一盏发光的复古灯笼轻轻抱在胸前。\"}", "detail": "温暖的灯光照亮了她的脸庞，并映照出飘落的雪花，营造出闪烁的高光。雪花柔和地落在她的大衣和头发上，而远处的森林则在寒冷的蓝色薄雾中保持模糊。", "atmosphere": "宁静、神奇、电影感、平和、感性、梦幻且永恒。", "lighting": "{argument name=\"lighting\" default=\"温暖的金色灯光与冷色调的暮色形成对比，体积光，逼真的光线穿过降雪产生散射，柔和的阴影，电影级光晕。\"}", "composition": "亲密的电影感肖像，居中构图，浅景深，奶油般虚化的背景，柔和模糊的雪林背景，平视视角。", "style": "照片级逼真，电影杰作，柯达胶片色彩，超逼真的皮肤纹理，写实的降雪效果，体积光，奶油般虚化，浅景深，HDR，8K，高度细节，获奖摄影作品。", "mood": "在冬日的寂静中，那一刻宁静的温暖与希望。" }

styles.name_en: Rotate a Wooden Chess Knight Through a Seamless Turntable
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Create a photorealistic studio turntable video of a polished wooden chess knight.

The knight has a minimalist carved horse silhouette: broad flat sides, a rounded elongated muzzle, a tiny dark eye, an angular ear, and a gently curved neck. A smooth, dark brown insert follows the mane along the back. The figure stands on a wide circular wooden base with several concentric stepped rings.

Use warm brown wood with clearly visible vertical grain, softly rounded edges, and a glossy lacquer finish. Preserve the exact shape, proportions, wood grain, and dark mane insert throughout the video.

The entire chess piece, including its base, rotates smoothly through one complete 360-degree turn around its vertical axis at a constant speed. It stays perfectly centered and firmly on the surface. The first and last frames match for a seamless loop.

Keep the camera completely stationary, looking slightly downward at the piece. Show the entire object with a small margin above and below. Use a seamless light-gray studio background and floor, soft diffused lighting, gentle highlights on the lacquer, and a subtle contact shadow beneath the base.

Duration: 3 seconds. Frame rate: 30 fps. Square 1:1 composition.

No camera movement, zoom, cuts, wobbling, floating, deformation, changing proportions, sliding wood textures, flickering, additional objects, text, or logos.

styles.name_en: Distant Observer: A Robot in the Rain
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Animate C05-K01 as the exact first frame of an 8-second photoreal 9:16 distant-observer video, one uninterrupted shot. C05-R01 is optional robot identity reference only if the tool supports an extra reference slot. If only one image is allowed, use C05-K01. Preserve its street layout, wet road, teal shutter, foreground doorway edge, robot size, umbrella, and flowerpot.

The camera remains inside the doorway across the street at the same approximately 25-meter distance. Match the robot's exact small standing scale in C05-K01 (about 18% of frame height in the supplied example), rather than enlarging it to meet a numerical target. As it bends, allow its projected height to decrease naturally; never enlarge it or move the camera to compensate. The viewer should feel they happened to notice a small event on the far sidewalk. Only very slight low-amplitude handheld drift, under 1% of frame width; no zoom, push-in, tracking toward the subject, close-up, camera cut, or dramatic rack focus. Foreground occlusion remains at the edges, never over the action.

0–2 seconds: the rust-red robot pauses under its open yellow umbrella and tilts its off-white head down toward the single terracotta pot and white flower beside it. Rain continues falling; the flower stem nods slightly. Keep exactly two eyes, no mouth, one olive hip pouch, and the same physical body proportions.
2–6 seconds: the robot bends at the knees and waist, using the hand already gripping the umbrella shaft to lower and move the still-open umbrella toward the pot. The umbrella moves as one rigid connected canopy-and-shaft assembly. Keep its grip continuous and do not swap hands. The free hand rests against its own thigh. The feet remain planted on the sidewalk. Finish with the canopy visibly centered above the pot while most of the robot's head and shoulders are outside its cover in the rain. The umbrella does not shrink, fold, detach, or touch the flower.
6–8 seconds: the robot holds the umbrella steady over the pot and quietly watches the flower. Rain remains visible around the canopy, and puddle rings continue on the road. End on this small act of care from the same distant viewpoint. The robot never notices or looks into the camera. No return to the starting pose and no loop.

Photoreal practical-effects character with believable joint motion, damp metal, soft daylight, and restrained movement. Optional audio: rain recorded from the sheltered camera position, with very faint mechanical movement at a …

## FORMAT
Match the exact aspect ratio and orientation of the attached reference image.
If the reference is horizontal, the illustration is horizontal.
If the reference is vertical, the illustration is vertical.
If the reference is square, the illustration is square.
One full-bleed handmade paper illustration.
No top/bottom split.
No photographic insert.
No diptych.
No letterboxing or added bars.

## ASPECT RATIO ADAPTATION
The output canvas must inherit the size relationship of the reference image.
Recompose the extracted elements to occupy that same proportion with intention.
Do not stretch, squash, or pad the drawing to fake another format.
Do not keep the original photograph's empty margins as dead space.
Use the full reference proportion as an editorial page: subject, a few supporting shapes, and paper ground arranged for that specific width and height.

## SUBJECT EXTRACTION
Study the attached reference image.
Preserve only:
- the most recognizable subject
- essential silhouette and proportions
- key pose or gesture
- important objects
- the core narrative relationship between people and objects

Highly simplify.
Remove unnecessary details.
Retain only the visual information needed for immediate recognition.

Never copy photographic texture, pores, lens blur, or camera grain into the illustration.
Never redraw the photograph as a painted photo.
Never keep the original photo visible.

## MEDIUM
Minimalist hand-drawn watercolor on paper.

Use:
- delicate, slightly imperfect hand-drawn lines
- transparent watercolor washes
- a small number of bold, clearly defined flat color shapes
- rough paper texture
- visible handmade brush marks
- slightly irregular, organic edges
- subtle pooling, bloom, and pigment granulation
- slight imperfections that make it feel genuinely handmade

The main illustrated subject should be small and carefully composed, occupying approximately 20–35% of the canvas.
Leave a large amount of negative space around the illustration, distributed according to the reference proportion.

## PAPER GROUND
The background should primarily resemble:
- rough white paper
- warm off-white paper
- pale natural paper
- minimal editorial book-cover stock

Use only a few lines or small watercolor shapes to suggest the surrounding environment.
Do not fill the page with a full scene.
Do not paint a photographic background.

## COLOR PALETTE
Extract the dominant colors directly from the attached reference image.
Compress the palette into no more than 4 main colors.
Keep the colors restrained, sophisticated, and harmonious.
Use bold but controlled flat watercolor blocks.
Avoid excessive color variation.
Preserve subtle paper grain and handmade brush texture.
The illustration should feel like a simplified watercolor interpretation of the reference, not a copy of it.

## TYPOGRAPHY
A small amount of simple typography may be included when it naturally fits.
Possible elements: a short title, keyword, object name, location, year, number, or short phrase.
Text should be minimal, understated, and editorial.
Place type in the negative space created by the reference proportion.
Do not force text into the composition if it does not naturally fit the subject.
No logos. No watermarks. No captions describing the image.

## VISUAL LANGUAGE
Quiet. Poetic. Refined. Minimal. Innocent. Relaxed. Artistic. Thoughtful. High-recognition. Premium.
Art-book cover. Independent publishing. Contemporary editorial design. Thoughtful picture book.

## NEGATIVE PROMPT
No original photograph in the frame, no split layout, no top photo / bottom drawing, no collage, no photomontage, no attached reference image, no photorealism, no camera look, no lens blur, no cinematic portrait, no beauty retouch, no extra people, no identity-heavy realism, no crowded composition, no full-bleed painted scene, no forced 3:4, no forced square, no letterboxing, no black bars, no stretched or squashed drawing, no unused margins copied from the photograph, no excessive detail, no more than four main colors, no loud typography, no logos, no watermarks, no HUD.

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Create a premium illustrated seafood advertising poster for a fictional coastal gourmet brand named TIDEKRAKEN, refined into a more elevated, more luxurious Orbit-plus-Transit direction. Design it as a single vertically composed commercial poster where a colossal fresh squid is the absolute hero ingredient, dominating the frame with sculptural elegance, while a curated micro-world of harbor life unfolds across its body, tentacles, docks, and surrounding water. Preserve the core structural brilliance of the reference as visual logic only: a monumental central squid, a seated adult female mascot on top, a bold title area in the upper-left, and richly layered miniature scenes distributed with disciplined rhythm around the product. The result must feel less like a cute festival cartoon and more like a globally awarded illustrated gourmet campaign: sophisticated, collectible, witty, and highly art-directed.

The squid is the central product icon and must feel irresistibly premium. Render it in a refined editorial illustration style with exquisite marine texture: warm coral-peach flesh, subtle paprika speckling, moist surface highlights, fleshy tentacle weight, elegant suction cup structure, clean natural anatomy, and a grand sculptural silhouette that reads instantly from afar. It is not grotesque, not comic-horror, and not chaotic; it is a majestic ingredient transformed into a monumental gourmet landscape. Every micro-scene on and around the squid must reinforce its desirability as the star ingredient.

The world built around the squid should be more curated and selective than before. Miniature harbor scenes still exist, but with stronger hierarchy and more breathing room: a few refined dock platforms, elegant seafood grilling stations, tasting tables, small fishing boats, hanging catch lines, and tiny market figures arranged with intentional spacing. Reduce low-value noise. Let the finest scenes feel like editorial vignettes rather than random crowd clutter. The lower tentacles should create graceful sweeping arcs that guide the eye through the poster like calligraphic strokes, supporting premium flow and graphic rhythm.

At the top of the squid sits an adult woman illustrated in a polished coastal editorial style, calm and inviting rather than overly playful. She wears a refined workwear-inspired outfit: headscarf, rolled sleeves, apron elements, relaxed trousers, and warm-toned footwear, all simplified into elegant shape language. She holds a squid skewer as a symbolic product cue. Her figure must be clearly adult, proportionally correct for an illustration, with balanced shoulders, natural seated weight, readable hands, five fingers when visible, and a poised posture. She acts as a brand ambassador, but she must remain secondary to the squid.

The environment should feel like a high-end harbor-food universe rather than a noisy fairground. Use pale open background space in the upper field to preserve poster sophistication. Around the lower half, integrate selective sea zones, weathered fishing boats, quiet gulls, rope textures, floating platforms, and a few smoke plumes from grills. Keep the micro-scenery rich but elegant, with better visual editing and more negative space than a dense children’s illustration. Think gourmet seasonal poster, not comic chaos.

Color hierarchy: 50% warm squid coral, shell pink, sea-salt peach, and grilled paprika tones; 20% marine blue, harbor teal, and muted weathered navy; 20% parchment white, mineral cream, and sun-faded neutral space; 10% charcoal ink linework, muted rust details, and typography. Use crisp linework, subtle gouache-watercolor fill behavior, restrained texture, and premium print clarity. The rendering should feel handcrafted and intelligent, with clean contour discipline and refined color separation. Make the palette slightly dustier, more elegant, and more internationally editorial.

Typography must be bolder in authority but more sophisticated in finish. In the upper-left, create a large custom black brush-lettered title block with stronger luxury poster rhythm, such as "SQUID SOCIETY" or "THE SQUID TABLE", stacked with dynamic but controlled shape energy. Beneath it, place only one short supporting line, minimal and sharp, such as "Season arrives in salt and fire." Reduce all other slogan text. Use only a few tiny designed signs inside the miniature market world, and keep them sparse, clean, and intentional. Typography must feel like part of the poster’s graphic composition, not scattered novelty signage.

Material and food cues must be luxurious and appetizing: glossy grilled glaze, charred edges on skewers, weathered dock wood, moist sea reflections, rope fibers, painted boats, smoke ribbons from seafood grills, clean market crates, and elegant plating details. The squid must remain fresh, premium, and desirable at every scale. The entire poster should feel like a Cannes-winning gourmet campaign that turns one iconic ingredient into a complete seasonal universe.

Output goal: one finished illustrated poster, premium commercial quality, product-dominant hierarchy, refined micro-storytelling, controlled negative space, elegant coastal energy, strong silhouette readability, bold collectible title design, and world-class poster finish.

Exclusion and quality constraints: no horror squid, no gore, no rotten seafood, no muddy textures, no low-end cartoon look, no chaotic crowd clutter, no deformed tentacles, no broken suction cups, no anatomy collapse, no childlike mascot proportions, no malformed hands, no extra fingers, no missing fingers, no fused fingers, no unreadable text, no random letters, no cheap festival flyer aesthetic, no style drift, no AI slop, no real brand names, no real person names.

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Create a premium automotive art-poster campaign for a fictional luxury grand touring brand named AVELORA, designed as a single vertical aerial composition with a monumental top-down perspective. Preserve the structural intelligence of the reference as pure visual architecture: a vast field of luminous coastal water on the left, a sun-scorched earthmass on the right, and a severe linear bridge running vertically near the right side of frame. The real hero product is a graphite metallic grand touring sedan traveling along the bridge, visually small yet compositionally dominant through placement, contrast, and the disciplined emptiness around it. The final image must feel more artistic, more elevated, and more like a museum-grade international advertising poster than a conventional car campaign.

The concept is that motion has carved a silent score into the landscape. The sea, coastline, agricultural geometry, shoreline curvature, wake lines, and land traces must imply rhythm, resonance, and orchestral order without becoming illustrative or literal. The image should feel like geography composed into music. The bridge reads like a single decisive line across a living canvas, and the car reads like the only note that matters.

On the left, the sea must be deep, mineral, and painterly in a photoreal way: saturated but elegant Mediterranean blue, teal depth shifts, pale wave edges, and elongated white wake trails from a few distant boats that feel like gestural strokes across the surface. On the right, the land must be dry, textural, and sculptural: terracotta fields, oxidized ochre soil, dusty umber, pale sand pockets, and one subtle spiral or calligraphic land trace embedded into the terrain as if the earth itself remembers movement. The coastline should feel naturally cut, irregular, and beautiful, with white shore foam and believable erosion lines. Every macro-shape must feel designed, but never artificial.

The car is a real premium sedan, highly photoreal and precisely engineered: low and elegant body line, dark panoramic roof glass, subtle metallic reflections, crisp window trim, refined wheel design, realistic tire contact, and a calm sense of speed rather than aggressive motion blur. The vehicle must remain legible despite its scale, through controlled road contrast, precise shadow, and exact positioning on the bridge. The bridge surface is immaculate dark asphalt with thin pale lane markings, engineered edges, and minimal structural interruption, rendered as a pure modernist line slicing through sea and land.

Color hierarchy: 55% luminous deep blue and teal water, 25% warm copper, rust, terracotta, and mineral earth, 10% charcoal bridge and graphite car, 10% soft white wake lines and typography. Lighting is high aerial daylight but refined into fine-art tonality: crisp coastal sun, sculpted texture in water and soil, exact white foam edges, very subtle atmospheric diffusion, and strong micro-contrast without harsh over-sharpening. The image must feel clean, expensive, breathable, and globally premium.

Typography must be fewer, colder, and more refined than before. Use only two text elements total. In the upper-left open water area, place one elegant headline: "Composed for Distance." Set in a modern refined sans-serif or restrained high-fashion serif-sans blend, bright white, carefully kerned, with quiet authority. In the upper-right, use a minimal brand block only: "AVELORA". No extra descriptors, no website, no explanatory copy, no information clutter. The typography should feel like a gallery-grade editorial intervention, suspended in the negative space, never competing with the landscape or the car.

Material semantics must be explicit and elevated: mineral-rich water depth, chalky coastline, dry agricultural soil, engineered asphalt, metallic automotive paint, reflective glass, subtle undercar shadow, and fine aerial photographic texture. The entire composition must read as a product-led luxury campaign where the car transforms the landscape into an emotional instrument of movement.

Rendering target: photoreal luxury automotive campaign, aerial fine-art realism, conceptually intelligent composition, premium editorial poster finish, clean negative space, restrained typography, world-class print quality, and seamless harmony between engineering, terrain, and visual poetry.

Structured exclusion constraints: no real car brands, no copied slogans, no garbled typography, no unreadable text, no extra vehicles cluttering the bridge, no low-resolution car, no distorted coastline, no cartoon music symbols, no warped bridge geometry, no muddy water, no dirty haze, no cheap tourism poster look, no oversaturated travel aesthetic, no style drift, no AI artifacts, no duplicate boats, no visual clutter.

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Use the uploaded image as the exact reference. Preserve the original subjects, identities, poses, composition, colors, lighting, background, and key details. Do not add, remove, or rearrange major elements.

Create a vertical 3:4 editorial poster with two sections:

- Top half: keep the original photo natural, sharp, and essentially unchanged.
- Bottom half: recreate the exact same scene as a refined hand-drawn illustration in soft watercolor, colored pencil, and fine ink sketch style.

Keep the same subjects, positions, perspective, and recognizable details. Use soft pastel tones, a warm off-white paper background, subtle paper texture, and a premium editorial / art-book / postcard feel. Add a soft seamless transition between the photo and illustration.

Add minimal elegant typography: a handwritten-style title and a small simple subtitle. Use context-appropriate text such as “A Brighter Day” and “A Slower Life”, or for pets/family “Good Friends”, “Brighter Days”, or “Happier Tails ♡”.

Optional: add a few subtle hand-drawn decorative details like tiny petals, leaves, hearts, or sketch marks only if they naturally fit.

Do not change identities or the scene, and do not make the lower section look like photorealism, 3D, anime, or cartoon.

styles.name_zh: 收藏式旅行纪念盒海报
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Create a premium 4:5 vertical Instagram travel poster for [COUNTRY], designed as part of a cohesive collectible “Souvenir Box” series.

Show an open vintage cardboard travel box containing exactly 10 culturally authentic souvenirs from [COUNTRY]: 1 hero object, 2–3 supporting objects, and additional smaller keepsakes. Choose objects with varied materials, sizes, shapes, and cultural significance.

Include exactly 4 paper elements:

- A folded illustrated map showing 4 different destinations
- A perforated vintage travel ticket
- A die-cut [COUNTRY] destination sticker
- One culturally appropriate paper-craft element

Use a warm textured-paper background with subtle fibers and imperfections. Place huge distressed condensed “[COUNTRY]” typography behind the box.

Develop a unique color palette inspired by the country's landscape, architecture, traditional crafts, and culture, using a dominant tone, secondary tone, warm neutral, accent, and dark text color.

Style

Premium tactile 3D collectible illustration + vintage international travel poster + editorial magazine cover + nostalgic packaging design. Use soft studio lighting, realistic contact shadows, subtle ambient occlusion, material grain, paper texture, and handmade imperfections. Keep it sophisticated and tactile rather than glossy CGI.

Add restrained travel ephemera: 4–7 stamps/badges/labels, an arrival mark, postage details, route arrows, coordinates, small travel metadata, a culturally appropriate local-language phrase, and:

“COLLECT MEMORIES NOT THINGS.”

Maintain a clear hierarchy:

COUNTRY title → hero souvenir → supporting objects → remaining keepsakes → graphic details.

Use strong negative space, balanced composition, rich but controlled detail, and excellent thumbnail readability.

Every country must receive a fresh, original composition based on its own cultural identity. Never copy another reference's layout, objects, typography arrangement, or visual composition.

{prompt}, {
  "prompt": "Subject: Genuine Chinese 20 Yuan Banknote (Guilin Landscape edition). 

[Macro Material Analysis]: The object must be rendered with the exact physical properties of real currency paper—matte cotton-fiber rag paper, NOT glossy cardboard. 

[Paper Engineering]: The karst mountain scenery is delicately cut and lifted. 
- **Critical Thickness**: The cut-out paper layers must appear razor-thin (0.1mm), fragile, and slightly translucent against the light. Edges should show microscopic fibrous tearing, not clean thick cuts.
- **Printing Texture**: The mountains are NOT solid colors. They must be composed of microscopic engraved lines (intaglio printing) and guilloche patterns. The ink should look slightly raised on the paper surface.

[Scene Context]: A realistic tiny bamboo raft floats on the flat printed water. 

[Scale Reference]: A giant, realistic human finger with distinct skin texture presses the edge of the bill. The finger is huge compared to the tiny raft, emphasizing the miniature scale.

[Photography]: Macro lens, high contrast lighting to show the texture of the paper fibers. Shallow depth of field.",

}

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 主题和形式：两位年轻女性朋友创作的高分辨率现代日本大头贴风格拼贴画。
布局：由 3x3 网格组成的单个图像（共 9 帧）。
主题：圣诞节 风格：生动、全彩、明亮、动感地再现现代日本大头贴灯光效果。
背景：简单的纯色或主题色背景（带有小爱心等精致装饰）。
摄影特点：每幅画面都有一条细细的白色或装饰性边框。景深浅（虚化）。

主题和姿势：
两位年轻的女性朋友，穿着符合主题的搭配服装。
生动、活泼、明快的表达。
这九张图清晰地描绘了以下列表中九种不同的流行大头贴姿势。

9 种不同的姿势（3x3 网格）：
第一行：
“抓头发爱心”姿势：一人俏皮地抓着头发，另一人用双手比出一个小爱心。两人都面带笑容。
“双手心形”姿势：两位伴侣用双手在中心形成一个大大的心形。脸上洋溢着灿烂快乐的笑容。
“捏手臂”姿势：两人双臂交叉，其中一人或两人都轻轻捏着对方的脸颊或手臂。表情生动活泼，充满喜悦。特写镜头展现对方的脸部。

第二排：4.“双臂交叉大爱心”姿势：两人双臂交叉，用空着的那只手比出一个大大的爱心。笑容灿烂而充满活力。5.“承诺之心”姿势：一人做出“手指发誓”的手势，另一人用手比出一个小爱心。笑容俏皮而温暖。6.“手牵手爱心”姿势：两人手牵手，各自用空着的那只手比出半个爱心，组成一个完整的爱心。笑容温柔甜美。

第三排：7.“双臂交叉撅嘴”姿势：两人双臂交叉，略带夸张的撅嘴或“得意”（或严肃）的表情，似乎在强忍着笑意。8.“双手合十，脸颊贴心”姿势：两人手牵着手，双手分别放在脸颊上，在脸颊周围画出一个心形。笑容可爱迷人。9.“双臂交叉，手心相印”姿势：两人双臂交叉，每人用一只手分别画出一个小的心形。笑容自信而时尚。特写镜头展现了他们的脸部。

其他装饰：
多个发光的霓虹心形图案叠加。
每一帧画面上，都以霓虹灯风格，沿着脸部的外轮廓写着与主题相关的字母。
在每个面板上添加多个符合主题的不同霓虹线条艺术涂鸦（例如星星、箭头、饱和线条、花朵、动物耳朵等）。
主要限制：所有9张照片必须保持主体、服装、背景风格和光线的严格一致性。浅景深，这是大头贴的典型特征。
请勿：添加任何文字、徽标、标签、水印、符号、数字或其他任何类型的文本元素（上述指定的文本元素和霓虹线条艺术涂鸦除外）。

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 将主体转化为一个视觉故事，通过 4–6 个小型插画帧 进行呈现。在保持主体可辨识度的同时，将其重新诠释为迷人的手绘序列，展示其食材、准备过程、质地和最终形态。

使用 暖色调奶油纸背景、精致的墨水轮廓、微妙的手写注释、微小的箭头、食材草图、测量标记以及不完美的印刷纹理。

构图应呈现出 古老烹饪速写本 页面的质感——充满艺术感、灵动、怀旧且经过精心策划。

不要仅仅复制照片，而是将主体转化为一段插画视觉叙事。

文章语言必须为英语，写作必须严格遵循第一行指定的 CEFR 英语等级。英语等级可选 A1、A2、B1、B2、C1 或 C2；“主题”为文章话题；“字数”为目标英文单词数。

英语难度要求：
- A1：非常基础，使用高频词汇和简单的短句。
- A2：常用生活词汇，简单的连接词和基础复合句。
- B1：更丰富的日常和抽象词汇，包含原因、示例和观点。
- B2：成熟的论证表达，词汇丰富，句式结构复杂且逻辑层次分明。
- C1：高级、准确且自然的英语，具备文学品质。
- C2：近乎母语者的文化评论或文学社论水平，运用细腻的修辞和抽象概念。

文章必须围绕指定主题展开，字数控制在目标字数的 ±10% 以内。排版应包含顶部的简洁报头（例如“THE LITERARY REVIEW”）、主标题使用优雅的高对比度衬线字体、作者署名以及三栏式社论网格。左侧包含一段醒目的粗体斜体引语，中心配有一张大型黑白纪实照片及说明文字。整体美学应克制、理性且具有学术感，使用带有轻微油墨晕染和颗粒感的米白色新闻纸纹理。仅限使用黑色、深灰色和米白色。底部应设有一个包含大型斜体行动号召（Call to Action）的信息框。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 创作一幅梦幻般的竖版故事书插画，采用反向绘制的彩色玻璃风格，具有半透明的层次感、精细的金色花丝轮廓、柔和的水彩质感以及明亮的反光。画面展示了 一只睡眼惺忪的圆滚滚仓鼠 在雨天清晨醒来，躺在深陷的奶油色绗缝床上，身旁是一扇高大的古老窗户；仓鼠有着棕白相间的毛发，小爪子搭在毯子上，粉嫩的鼻子，乌黑发亮的眼睛，正困倦地眨着眼。窗外是雨水冲刷过的朦胧蓝灰色欧洲哥特式城市，有着陡峭的屋顶、塔楼、温暖的黄色灯光、雾气和风暴云。室内采用温馨的天体主题：蓬松的奶油色被子上绣着金色的星星和新月，点缀着蓝色拼布，仓鼠身边塞着一只毛绒小羊，温暖的灯光与寒冷的雨天室外形成对比。在窗户附近的空中包含 3 条半透明的玻璃鱼：右侧中心偏大的一条，左下角一条小的，以及大鱼下方一条极小的。在鱼之间包含 5 个漂浮的小玻璃气泡和 1 颗发光的玻璃星星。添加 2 个水晶球：左侧悬挂着一个装有精致金枝的大球，右侧桌面上摆放着一个装有新月和星星的球。右上角添加 1 条悬挂的新月水晶装饰链。右侧窗台上摆放着精致的白花，左下角前景处有模糊的深色叶片植物。色调应为 朦胧的粉蓝色、珍珠奶油色、柔和的金色和温暖的琥珀色；光影应呈现出 宁静的雨天黎明，温馨而神奇 的感觉。使用竖版 2:3 构图，高度细节化，带有闪烁的玻璃高光，柔和的景深，无文字，无水印。

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, High-impact e-commerce infographic for "Apple Pods Pro 3" 
premium wireless over-ear headphones.

FOREGROUND - PRODUCT HERO SHOT
Extreme close-up of a hand holding a sleek, 
matte-white premium over-ear headphone toward the camera 
at a slight angle. The headphone features:
- Glossy white ear cushions with soft memory foam padding
- Brushed aluminum silver headband with subtle Apple Pods 
  Pro 3 embossed branding
- Black mesh speaker grille visible on the ear cup face
- A tiny glowing green LED status indicator on the 
  right ear cup edge
- Subtle touch-control icons etched on the outer cup surface

Macro-lens shallow depth of field — hand and headphone 
slightly blurred at edges to create cinematic depth. 
Product remains razor-sharp in center frame.

CENTRAL SUBJECT — MODEL
In the mid-ground: a smiling young woman with freckles 
and wavy pastel-pink hair. She wears:
- A vibrant lime-green knit beanie
- A psychedelic black and white-striped long-sleeve shirt
- The white over-ear headphones resting stylishly 
  around her neck (not on ears) — one hand casually 
  touching the ear cup

Expression: relaxed, confident, joyful. 
She is glancing slightly off-camera with a natural smile.

BACKGROUND & ATMOSPHERE
Clean soft-focus studio backdrop — light gray gradient 
fading to warm white at center. 

Atmospheric overlays:
- Diagonal rainbow prism lens flares cutting across 
  upper-left to lower-right
- Soft pastel light leaks in pink and yellow at corners
- 4–5 blurred white over-ear headphones floating 
  artistically in the background at various depths

styles.name_zh: 台州手绘城市美食地图
styles.prompt: {prompt}, following this scene brief: 一张手绘风格的城市美食地图，以台州为主题。画面以鸟瞰视角的手绘简化城市地图为底，标注椒江、路桥、黄岩等区域和灵江、台州湾等水系地标，不追求精确比例而是追求可爱的水彩手绘感。地图上分布着12个美食地点的精致手绘小插画：1. 椒江老粮坊的蛋清羊尾（金黄蓬松的蛋泡甜点撒着糖粉，筷子夹起拉丝）2. 临海紫阳古街的食饼筒（一个饱满的麦饼卷切开露出肉丝、蛋皮、米面等丰富馅料）3. 三门的青蟹（一只肥硕的青壳大蟹张着大钳子，旁边一小碟姜醋）4. 温岭石塘渔港的海鲜面（粗瓷大碗浓白鱼汤面铺满虾、蛏子、小黄鱼）5. 路桥的糟羹（一锅稠厚的五彩羹，芥菜、冬笋、香干、牡蛎粒粒可见）6. 玉环坎门的炊圆（三四个白胖糯米团子卧在笼屉里，旁边酱油碟滴着麻油）7. 黄岩的麦虾（陶锅里面疙瘩配蛤蜊、青菜翻滚冒泡）8. 仙居的八大碗（八只粗陶小碗围成一圈——土鸡、溪鱼、豆腐皮俱全）9. 天台的饺饼筒（几卷金黄酥脆的薄饼整齐码放，露出红烧肉和豆面馅）10. 临海的麦油脂（竹盘上摊着薄如蝉翼的饼皮卷着肉末、豆芽、鸡蛋丝）11. 温岭的嵌糕（厚实的年糕饼中间嵌着红烧肉和油条，正在铁板上滋滋作响）12. 椒江的姜汁调蛋（一只青花碗里琥珀色姜汤卧着嫩滑蛋花，撒几粒核桃碎）。每个插画约占地图5%面积，旁边用手写体标注店名和一句推荐语如“阿婆凌晨四点就起来和面”“本地人认准这口锅”。地图边缘用手绘藤蔓、杨梅枝和小海鲜（虾、蟹、贝壳）装饰形成边框。右下角有一个手绘指南针（标注“东海”方向）和图例说明。左上角标题“台州·山海食光地图”使用胖圆的手绘美术字，用杨梅和小黄鱼点缀装饰。整体画风为水彩+彩铅混合的手绘质感，颜色以杨梅红、姜黄、海蓝、翠绿为主，图片比例1:1。

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 1. 风格调性 
  - 关键词： Shin-hanga (新版画风格), Ukiyo-e Aesthetics (浮世绘美学), Serene Melancholy, Atmospheric landscape, Traditional Japanese Art.
  - 描述： 画面呈现出 20 世纪初日本“新版画”运动的典型特征，结合了传统浮世绘的木刻技法与西方印象派的光影氛围。整体气质静谧、孤寂且充满诗意。核心在于捕捉特定的气候氛围与瞬间的静止感。
2. 视觉逻辑 
  1. Perspective: 散点透视与高视点结合。非严格的西方单点透视，强调平面的纵深感。
  2. Composition: 强烈的对角线构图，利用大面积留白与实体景物形成虚实对比。
  3. Geometry: 有机线条与几何色块的叠加。景物边缘清晰但不过度锐利，呈现出版画特有的刻刀雕琢感。
3. 视觉渲染 
  1. Line Work: 墨线轮廓，线条粗细变化模仿毛笔笔触，但在建筑和树枝细节上保持木刻的刚劲。
  2. Texture: 显著的和纸纹理，利用纸张原本的白色作为高光。
  3. Technique: Bokashi: 在水面和天空中使用渐变印染技法，表现色彩的柔和过渡。
  4. Goma-zuri: 局部可能存在的“胡麻摺”效果，产生颗粒感以模拟降雪或质感。
  5. Lighting: 漫射光。无明确光源方向，通过色块明度差异表现积雪的厚度与阴天光感。
4. 色彩系统 
  1. Core Logic: 低饱和度，冷色调主导，极简主义配色。
  2. Palette:
    - Prussian Blue / Indigo (#1B365D): 用于水面渐变，深邃且沉静。
    - Slate Grey (#708090): 用于天空与阴影，营造寒冷氛围。
    - Paper White / Cream (#F5F5DC): 画布底色，直接指代积雪。
    - Charcoal Black (#36454F): 用于树木与建筑剪影。
5. 负向约束
  1. 严禁照片级真实感、物理渲染
  2. 严禁数字绘画的光滑感、高光反射、塑料质感。
  3. 严禁厚涂笔触、油画堆叠感。
  4. 严禁体积光、环境光遮蔽等现代 3D 渲染技法。
  5. 严禁使用鲜艳、高纯度的霓虹色或原色。
6. 画面内容
  大雪天气，《鬼灭之刃》所有「柱」的定妆照，每个「柱」都按自己的呼吸法做战斗准备姿势。

styles.name_zh: COLOR PALETTE - BLUEPRINT & POP LOGIC风格
styles.prompt:
{prompt}, 【COLOR PALETTE - BLUEPRINT & POP LOGIC】
- BACKGROUND: Professional grayish-white or faint blueprint grid texture (#F2F2F2).
- SYSTEMIC BASE: Muted Teal/Sage Green (#B8D8BE) for major functional blocks and stable data zones.
- HIGH-ALERT ACCENT: Vibrant Fluorescent Pink (#E91E63) strictly for "Pitfalls", "Critical Warnings", or the single most important "Winner" data point.
- MARKER HIGHLIGHTS: Vivid Lemon Yellow (#FFF200) used as a translucent highlighter effect for keywords.
- LINE ART: Ultra-fine Charcoal Brown (#2D2926) for technical grids, coordinates, and hair-lines.

【LAYOUT & INFORMATION DENSITY】
- INFORMATION AS COORDINATES: Every module must have a coordinate-style label (e.g., R-20, G-02, SEC-08).
- THE "LAB MANUAL" AESTHETIC: Use a mix of microscopic details (technical drawings) and macroscopic data (large bold headers).
- HIGH DENSITY: Pack 6-7 distinct modules per image. Minimize margins; every corner should contain metadata like tiny bar codes, time stamps, or technical parameters.
- VISUAL CONTRAST: Use massive bold typography for primary headers, contrasted with tiny, ultra-crisp technical annotations (8pt look).

【ILLUSTRATION & GRAPHIC ELEMENTS】
1. TECHNICAL DIAGRAMS: Instead of cute icons, use exploded views, cross-sections with anchor points, and architectural skeletal lines.
2. COORDINATE SYSTEMS: Use vertical/horizontal rulers with precise markers (e.g., 0.5mm, 1.8mm, 45°) to show quality levels.
3. DATA BLOCKS: Use "Marker-over-Print" look—color blocks should be slightly offset from the text they highlight, creating a postmodern print feel.
4. SYMBOLS: Include cross-hair targets, mathematical symbols (Σ, Δ, ∞), and directional arrows (X/Y axis).

【SPECIFIC MODULE STRUCTURE - MUST HAVE 6-7】
- [MOD 1: BRAND ARRAY] - Reference Figure 1's grid: A 4x4 or 3x3 matrix of options, with one "Best Choice" highlighted in Fluorescent Pink.
- [MOD 2: SPECS SCALE] - A technical ruler or gauge showing "Standard" vs "Premium" with precise numerical increments.
- [MOD 3: DEEP DIVE] - A technical sketch of the product with "zoom-in" callout circles showing internal components.
- [MOD 4: SCENARIO GRID] - Comparison cards separated by fine 0.5pt hair-lines.
- [MOD 5: WARNING ZONE] - A high-contrast Pink/Black area for "Pitfalls to Avoid".
- [MOD 6: QUICK CHECK] - A small, dense summary table resembling a lab data sheet.
- [MOD 7: STATUS BAR] - A vertical or horizontal stack of information blocks like Figure 2's class schedule.

【TYPOGRAPHY】
- Headers: Bold Brutalist Chinese characters, high impact.
- Body: Professional sans-serif or crisp handwritten technical print.
- Numbers: Large, highlighted with Yellow or Blue to stand out.

【AVOID】
- ❌ NO cute/cartoonish doodles.
- ❌ NO soft pastels or generic textures.
- ❌ NO empty white space.
- ❌ NO flat vector stock icons.

・描画スタイル：アイソメトリック（斜め上からの俯瞰視点）のラインアートに、明るいパステルカラーを塗り重ねたスタイル。

・複雑すぎて視認性を損なう過剰な書き込み。
・フラットすぎる2Dデザイン（立体感を重視すること）。

{prompt}, # 指示
[ユーザーが入力: テーマやコンセプト]について、清潔感のある寒色系カラーパレットとフラットなイラストを用いた、ライフスタイル提案型のコンセプトビジュアルを作成せよ。（色バリエーション：クールトーン）


# レイアウト要件
・全体構成：グリッドに縛られない散布的なフリーレイアウト（スキャッター配置）を採用し、複数の異なるシーンを画面全体にバランスよく配置する
・テキスト配置：各イラストシーンのすぐ近く（横または下）に、対応するキャッチコピー（太字の小見出し）と補足テキスト（細字）のセットを配置する
・階層構造：左上（または四隅のいずれか）に全体のメインタイトルを配置し、視線の入り口を作る
・空間利用：各シーン間に十分なネガティブスペース（余白）を設け、要素が混雑しないようにする
・情報の流れ：特定の順序を強制せず、視線が自由に各シーンを回遊できるような構成にする


# デザイン要件
・カラーパレット：深いネイビーブルー、鮮やかなシアン（水色）、クールグレー、白の4色程度に厳密に限定する
・イラストスタイル：主線なし（または極細線）のフラットデザイン。人物は顔のパーツを描かないミニマルなスタイルを採用
・アクセント表現：シアンの幾何学的なシェイプ（三角形や台形）を「スポットライト」や「背景アクセント」として使用し、各シーンを強調・統一する
・地面の表現：薄いクールグレーの楕円形や不定形のシェイプを足元に敷き、簡易的なステージ（空間）を定義する
・背景色：白、または極めて薄いブルーグレーを使用し、清潔でシャープな印象にする
・タイポグラフィ：装飾のないシンプルなサンセリフ体（ゴシック体）。文字色はネイビーを使用する
・全体的な雰囲気：知的、誠実、爽やか、先進的、プロフェッショナル
・避けるべき表現：暖色系の色使い、手書き風の崩した線、過度な装飾、重厚なテクスチャ
・フォーマット：横長（16:9比率推奨）、高解像度

・アクセント：強調の囲みやチェックマークは、色チョークで強く擦り付けたように表現。
・イラスト：白や色チョークによるラフな描画。消しゴムで消した跡がうっすら残っていても良い。

・[図解・ダイアグラムの配置]: 中央に全体を象徴するメインビジュアル（またはロゴ）を配置し、それを囲むように各事業・技術の具体例を配置する。
・[矢印・接続線の使い方]: 動きを感じさせる破線や、要素から飛び出すような斜めのラインを多用し、エネルギーの流れや関連性を表現する。

・[イラスト・アイコン]: 繊細な細線で描かれたテクニカルイラスト。リアルすぎず、図面のような精密さと可愛らしさを両立させる。
・[視覚的な整理手法]: 重要な数値やキーワードは赤い吹き出しや丸囲み（バッジ）の中に入れ、視覚的なアクセントにする。
・[全体的な雰囲気・トーン]: 専門的な技術を分かりやすく、かつワクワクさせるような「技術図鑑」や「企業広告」風のトーン。
・[避けるべき表現]: 重厚すぎる写真、多色使い、静的な均等割りのグリッド。
・[フォーマット:解像度、アスペクト比]: A4または新聞広告のような縦長/横長の印刷フォーマット。

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, # 指示
[ソース情報]について、以下の指示をもとに日本語でインフォグラフィックを作成してください。
内容に合った図解を必要に応じて使うこと。あくまで参照レベルであり一番に優先することは読み手へのわかりやすさを考慮すること。


# 図解の種類（参照）
- 概念図：二軸図、ベン図、プロセス図、ステップ図
- フロー図・プロセス図: 縦ステップフロー、縦ライン＋番号ノード、フローチャート、スイムレーン図
- 比較図: 左右2カラム比較、3列比較、棒グラフ比較
- 循環図: 4項目循環、3要素循環（三角）
- 時系列図: タイムライン
- 階層図: ピラミッド
- ステップ図: 階段状ステップ
- 一覧レイアウト: 表、カードグリッド、箇条書きカード、FAQ、画像＋テキスト2カラム
- 指標・進捗: KPIタイル、進捗表示


# 図解の基本ルール（参照）
- 四角図形と丸図形: 四角（安定、構造的、システム、完成）、丸（広がり、有機的、ランダム、変化）
- 吹き出し: 実線（通常）、点線（補足、心の声）、変形（強調、ざわめき、かけ声）
- 囲み: 実線（通常、汎用性）、二重線（強調）、点線（仮定、未来、補足）
- 矢印: 実線（通常、汎用性）、二重線（強調）、波線（混沌、瞑想、障害）、点線（仮定、未来、補足）
- 文章の図解: ①状態・構造（直線でつなぐ、図形が並列に並ぶ）、②因果関係・変化（矢印で変化を示す、時系列に並べる）、③拡散・収束・収集（1つのパーツから多岐に渡る矢印、1つのパーツに矢印が向かう）
- 時系型: 縦レイアウト（2分割）、横レイアウト（3分割）
- 発散型: タイトルを中心に、グルーピングは同じ色の線や種類で
- ランダム型: 区切り線で2分割にして、向かって右と下部に逆L字型の「余白」を作る。メイン内容は2分割エリアに、意見や質疑などは余白にまとめる。


# デザイン要件
- 背景: 白背景(#FFFFFF)
- スタイル: 清涼感のあるインフォグラフィック
- 配色: オーシャンブルー（#0369A1）＋ケリーグリーン（#22C55E）＋ゴールド（#D97706）で色は「ベタ塗り（Flat Color）」で統一
- タイポグラフィ: Noto Sans JPのファミリーで読みやすい日本語
- アイコン選定: 文脈に即したシンプルな「フラットアイコン」を使用（例：計画＝カレンダー、分析＝グラフ）
- アスペクト比: 16:9
- 全体の情報密度: 50％


# 避けるべき表現
- 陰影禁止: ドロップシャドウ、立体感、エンボス加工は一切禁止
- 写実的すぎるリアルな描写（実写インセットを除く）
- 暗い色調やビジネスライクな堅苦しいフォント
- 余白のない詰め込みすぎたレイアウト
- 英語のみの仕上がり

・【自由な配置】厳格な直線ではなく、わずかに要素を傾けることで、親しみやすさとリズムを出す。


# デザイン要件
・【カラー】背景は生成り色（クリーム）。メインカラーは「テラコッタ（レンガ色）」や「マスタードイエロー」。
・【文字】角が丸いラウンドゴシック体、または丁寧に書かれた手書き風フォント。
・【イラスト】チョークアートやサインペンで描いたような、少しラフな質感のピクトグラム。
・【雰囲気】優しい、安心感、アットホーム、誠実。
・【アスペクト比】3:4（掲示板ポスター向け）

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, # 指示
[ユーザーが入力: テーマやコンセプト]について、温かみのある暖色系カラーパレットとフラットなイラストを用いた、ライフスタイル提案型のコンセプトビジュアルを作成せよ。（色バリエーション：ウォームトーン）


# レイアウト要件
・全体構成：グリッドに縛られない散布的なフリーレイアウト（スキャッター配置）を採用し、複数の異なるシーンを画面全体にバランスよく配置する
・テキスト配置：各イラストシーンのすぐ近く（横または下）に、対応するキャッチコピー（太字の小見出し）と補足テキスト（細字）のセットを配置する
・階層構造：左上（または四隅のいずれか）に全体のメインタイトルを配置し、視線の入り口を作る
・空間利用：各シーン間に十分なネガティブスペース（余白）を設け、要素が混雑しないようにする
・情報の流れ：特定の順序を強制せず、視線が自由に各シーンを回遊できるような構成にする


# デザイン要件
・カラーパレット：落ち着いたテラコッタオレンジ、温かみのあるクリームイエロー、ウォームグレー、オフホワイトの4色程度に厳密に限定する
・イラストスタイル：主線なし（または極細線）のフラットデザイン。人物は顔のパーツを描かないミニマルなスタイルを採用
・アクセント表現：クリームイエローの幾何学的なシェイプ（三角形や台形）を「スポットライト」や「背景アクセント」として使用し、各シーンを強調・統一する
・地面の表現：薄いウォームグレーの楕円形や不定形のシェイプを足元に敷き、簡易的なステージ（空間）を定義する
・背景色：非常に薄いオフホワイトまたはアイボリーを使用し、柔らかく温かい印象にする
・タイポグラフィ：装飾のないシンプルなサンセリフ体（ゴシック体）。文字色は濃いウォームグレーを使用する
・全体的な雰囲気：温かい、親しみやすい、落ち着き、心地よさ、ナチュラル
・避けるべき表現：寒色系の色使い、リアルな陰影、グラデーション、過度な書き込み、複雑なテクスチャ
・フォーマット：横長（16:9比率推奨）、高解像度

styles.prompt:
{prompt}, Use the uploaded image as the one and only product reference. Preserve the jewelry exactly as it is, with high fidelity to its original design, shape, proportions, gemstone arrangement, metal tone, craftsmanship, setting, texture, and identity. Do not redesign, simplify, or alter the jewelry itself in any way. Keep the product accurate, luxurious, and instantly recognizable.

Create an extraordinary luxury jewelry campaign image where the product is the absolute visual hero. Build a bold, artistic, and premium scene around it that feels cinematic, elegant, and visually unforgettable. The result must never feel like a basic catalog shot or a repetitive product render.

For every generation, create a different visual concept so the outputs do not look similar to one another. Vary the composition, environment, supporting element, texture, background structure, framing, angle, and styling approach each time. Each image should feel unique, fresh, and creatively elevated while still maintaining a refined luxury identity.

Include one or more strong supporting natural or tactile elements that help frame and enhance the jewelry, such as a branch, hand, leaf, stone, bark, flower petal, sand texture, silk fold, glass reflection, water ripple, smoke, shell, or sculptural organic form. These elements should not distract from the product, but should artistically support it and make it feel more premium, emotional, and visually magnetic.

Use color contrast intelligently. Place the jewelry within a scene that uses an opposite or contrasting color tone to make the piece stand out strongly, while still keeping the palette harmonious, tasteful, and luxurious. The contrast should feel intentional and sophisticated, never random or harsh. The product must pop clearly from the scene through contrast in color, texture, light, or material.

Use strong visual hierarchy, elegant negative space, and a striking focal composition that makes the jewelry dominate the frame. The product should feel iconic, powerful, and highly desirable. Emphasize macro-level detail, realistic sparkle, gemstone brilliance, polished metal reflections, fine craftsmanship, prongs, edges, texture, and premium material depth.

Lighting should be cinematic and refined, with soft directional light, controlled highlights, elegant shadows, subtle rim light, atmospheric glow, and beautiful depth. Use shallow depth of field and macro product-photography aesthetics to keep the jewelry crisp and visually commanding.

The final image should feel like a world-class luxury editorial ad from a top creative studio: visually bold, highly refined, emotionally captivating, and far beyond ordinary product photography.

Avoid repeated concepts, repeated props, repeated backgrounds, flat lighting, weak framing, visual clutter, cheap styling, generic catalog presentation, text, watermark, and logos.

styles.prompt: {prompt}, A highly detailed vertical Taoist esoteric infographic poster in the style of an ancient Chinese religious scroll, printed on aged beige rice paper with fine ornamental borders, inked calligraphy, faded stains, and classical diagram annotations. At the top center, large black brush-calligraphy title text reads {argument name="headline text" default="道·三魂七魄"}. Directly below the title is a smaller paragraph of classical Chinese explanatory text in neat calligraphy. The composition is perfectly symmetrical and centered on a glowing vertical spiritual axis made of white-gold energy, mist, and lightning-like qi currents running from the bottom of the page to the heavens. At the very top, above the axis, depict 3 seated Taoist immortals or deities on clouds in a golden celestial realm, arranged left, center, and right, with halos and flowing robes in muted green, cream, and blue. Beneath them, create a towering multi-layered cosmological body diagram made of 9 stacked circular realms or platforms connected by swirling clouds and luminous energy. The upper 5 larger realms represent the five zang organs as miniature mythic landscapes: 1 forested green realm labeled liver/wood, 1 fiery red-gold temple city realm labeled heart/fire, 1 yellow earth realm with terraces labeled spleen/earth, 1 silver-blue mountain-and-water realm labeled lung/metal, and 1 dark blue watery abyss realm labeled kidney/water. Place a glowing meditating figure in a bright orb at the center junction between the upper organ realms and lower spirit layers. {prompt}, Aspect Ratio: 9:16 Vertical

【IDENTITY & REALISM (CRITICAL PRIORITY)】

The subject is an adult female whose facial features and bone structure must 100% perfectly match the provided FACE_REF image. Eye spacing, nose bridge, jawline, and cheekbone structure must be exact; no identity drift is allowed. Skin texture must be photorealistic, showing pores and fine details—do not over-smooth or apply an Instagram filter look.

【PHOTOGRAPHY & CINEMATOGRAPHY】

A high-end editorial fashion photograph with a cinematic quality, rivaling covers of Vogue, Harper’s Bazaar, or ELLE.

Lens & Focus: Use an 85mm lens (for medium shot) or 50mm/70mm (for full body) with a shallow depth of field. The subject's eyes must be perfectly sharp.

Lighting: Natural winter daylight supplemented by soft, professional fill light. Gold ornaments and precious stones should have realistic specular highlights without being blown out. Embroidery textures must be incredibly sharp and tactile.

Color Grading: Rich, cinematic colors. The red walls and the attire's main color must be distinct and clean, not muddy. The overall image should feel deep, textured, and expensive.

Composition: A clean magazine cover layout with deliberate negative space at the top or sides for typography. No torn paper or hand-drawn effects.

【SETTING: FORBIDDEN CITY WINTER】

The location is a red-walled long corridor in the Beijing Forbidden City.

Environment: Visible details include vermilion walls, red pillars, intricate carved windows, and painted wooden beams with strong perspective depth. The scene must be clean: no tourists, modern signs, or watermarks.

Weather Condition (Selected Randomly):

[If Snowfall selected]: Fine snowflakes are gently falling.

[If Post-Snow selected]: The air is crisp and clear, with remnant snow on the eaves and steps.

【WARDROBE: MING DYNASTY HEAVY INDUSTRY COUTURE】

The subject wears opulent, multi-layered Ming Dynasty ceremonial Hanfu. The aesthetic is gold-heavy, dense tassels, phoenix crown, large-area woven gold embroidery, complex layering, dignified and luxurious.

Structure: A visible, crisp white standing inner collar provides a clean boundary. Over this is a structured duijin ao (jacket) with wide sleeves, topped by a heavy xiapei/pibo (stole) structure held by a large central yajin ornament.

Fabric & Craft: The main fabric is real zhijin jin (woven gold brocade) with palpable fiber texture. The embroidery is heavy industry—using panjin goldwork, couched gold

styles.name_en: narrow Tokyo backstreet izakaya entrance with red lanterns and wet stone pavemen
styles.prompt: {prompt}, Luxury hospitality / travel editorial photograph of a narrow Tokyo backstreet izakaya entrance at dusk. Over-the-shoulder POV as if walking into the alley, subtle handheld micro-motion, medium-format digital look, 35mm or 50mm lens, f/5.6, ISO 200. Wet stone pavement reflecting light, red paper lanterns glowing at the doorway, wooden façade, noren curtain, small metal details, cold aluminum tones. Overcast soft skylight with even wrap-around illumination. Color palette: neon pink-purple sunset tint in the sky reflections, midnight navy shadows, cool aluminum highlights; tasteful, not oversaturated. Composition with leading lines into the scene, human presence implied but no visible faces or crowds; a single blurred shoulder edge in foreground optional. Leave diagonal corner negative space in the upper-right for stamp-style copy. Atmosphere: lively weekend energy with friends implied, sensory realism (cool air, scent of grilled skewers) through detail. Post: natural film-like contrast, restrained shadow lift, Kodak Portra 400 emulation, no artificial bloom, no HDR. Negative: no text, no logos, no watermarks, no duplicated windows, no CGI/plastic surfaces, no neon over-saturation, no crowding.

styles.prompt: {prompt}, Luxury ocean-view hotel suite interior in Jeju, South Korea, travel editorial architectural hero photograph. Low-angle wide composition, floor-to-ceiling window framing vivid turquoise Jeju water and a vast clear midday sky occupying upper 2/3 of the frame. Medium-format digital look, 35mm or 50mm lens perspective, f/5.6, ISO 200, handheld with subtle natural micro-motion realism. Leading lines from warm wood floor and minimalist furniture guide toward the window; implied human presence (a slightly rumpled linen throw, half-open balcony door, gently displaced curtain) but no people. Leave diagonal corner negative space in the upper-right for stamp-style copy. Lighting: strong directional midday sun, controlled specular highlights on stone and glass, crisp but not harsh. Color palette: persimmon orange accents (throw pillow or art object), hanji cream walls/linen, ink gray stone or metal details, bamboo green plant. Atmosphere: milestone anniversary stay, cinematic refined elegance; tactile wood/stone/linen textures, airy sea-breeze suggestion. Post: natural film-like contrast, restrained shadow lift, Kodak Portra 400 emulation, no artificial bloom, no HDR. Negative: no text, no logos, no watermarks, no crowds, no duplicated windows, no fake CGI surfaces, no neon oversaturation.

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 商业物品拍摄，轻法式原木风，采用高角度斜向俯拍，既能完整展现餐桌的布置细节，又通过部分露出的椅子营造出即将入座的生活场景感，餐布的纵向条纹 + 蕾丝花边形成隐形引导线，将视线从画面花艺 + 烛台（点缀氛围）自然引向餐桌中央的餐点区域，餐桌的长方形轮廓，配合餐布的纵向线条，弱化了斜俯拍的随意感，让细节布置显得有序；原木的暖调、餐布的柔软蕾丝、花瓶的细腻质感结合，既保留了田园风的松弛，又有法式的精致，选取厨房操作区+餐桌的联动区域，用斜向视角同时展现两个功能区，既体现了空间的开放性，又避免了大面积取景的杂乱感；柜体的水平线条、餐桌的斜向轮廓，窗户的自然光从左侧射入，百叶窗透入的条纹光影，让原木材质的纹理更清晰，同时给静态空间注入动态感；留白区域（墙面、桌面空白处）则给视觉透气，避免元素堆砌带来的拥挤感。高饱和度的色彩运用，使环境色泽鲜艳夺目，吸引眼球，比例 「9:16」

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 这是一幅充满田园诗意的户外茶歇场景图，整体风格清新明亮，仿佛将人带入一处世外桃源。 - 天空与远景：湛蓝的天空中点缀着蓬松的白云，右侧的阳光耀眼夺目，洒下金色的光芒。几只飞鸟在天际翱翔，为画面增添了灵动气息。远处是层层叠叠的绿色梯田（似茶园），与蓝天绿树构成了开阔又富层次感的背景。 - 植物与环境：近处的草地翠绿如绒，上方有茂密的绿叶形成天然“画框”。还有修剪整齐的球形灌木、盛放的白色花卉（如右侧花篮、左下角花丛），满眼绿意与繁花交织，尽显自然生机。 - 茶歇场景：前景是一套铁艺户外桌椅，椅子配浅蓝色坐垫，木质圆桌上摆放着白色茶具——茶壶、茶杯、带盖茶罐还冒着袅袅热气，仿佛茶香四溢。旁边的编织藤箱上静置着一只白瓷茶壶，右侧花篮里的白花与绿植相映成趣，整体营造出宁静惬意的田园茶歇氛围，仿佛让人能在此享受一段悠闲的晨光时光。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 烘焙美食桂花糕海报：桂花糕×蜂蜜 暖米色到浅咖色的柔和渐变背景，无多余杂质，浅竹制高脚托盘稳置于画面中心，托盘的竹纹自然舒展，带着清雅的哑光质感。3块桂花糕切块堆叠在托盘内，糕体的米白色泽温润，表面嵌着细密的金黄桂花，表面带“桂花糕”纹路，质地松软细腻。原木小勺悬于桂花糕上方，勺内清亮的蜂蜜呈粘稠状缓缓倾倒，浆流如丝般垂落，淋在桂花糕表面后，顺着糕体的棱角慢慢滑落，在糕面汇成透亮的糖渍，桂花的金黄在糖浆下更显鲜亮。一瓶蜂蜜于托盘左侧，托盘旁边有散落的桂花，画面左上角右一支桂花树支探出来，绳结的细节清晰可辨。略微俯视的视角，侧逆光打亮主体，在蜂蜜的流动轨迹上形成晶莹高光，在桂花糕的哑光表面形成柔和的明暗过渡，竹制托盘的纹理在光影下更显质朴。画面右上角竖排文案 “蜂蜜桂花糕”，旁边“中式糕点”，中景深锁定核心细节，胶片颗粒质感加持，整体画面清雅复古，传递“清甜与软糯相融”的中式点心风味感。

styles.name_zh: 复古情绪烘焙杂志大片
styles.prompt: {prompt}, 采用复古情绪感的商业精修摄影风格，融合优雅的杂志版式设计。竖版画幅，运用微仰视的近景特写视角。主体是两块（或两盒）手工巧克力，包装纸采用复古插画风格，它们以堆叠的方式（一块平放，一块斜靠）放置在画面中央。背景是它们被放置在一块粗糙的、深色的胡桃木砧板上。整个场景的远景背景是一面深棕色或墨绿色的墙面，墙面被当作画布，用于文案排版。细节修饰包括巧克力包装纸的哑光纤维质感、木板的深刻纹理，以及旁边点缀的一两颗烘焙过的咖啡豆。光影色调为戏剧性的暗色调（Low-key），使用单一的、强烈的伦勃朗光（从左上方45度角）打来，在木板上投下深邃的阴影，精准勾勒出巧克力的轮廓，氛围感浓郁。文案排版采用复古杂志风格，“CHOCOLATE” 和 “Velvet” 等词使用大号、优雅的金色衬线字体（如Didot或Script字体）错落排版在顶部背景上；“品味可可的诗意” 作为Slogan，使用白色小号宋体水平排版在产品下方的留白处。整体美学追求复古、高级和故事感，利用材质的粗糙与光滑对比，以及光影的戏剧性，营造出宁静、奢华的氛围。要求8K超高清，专业摄影，电影级画质，质感细腻，商业级品质。

styles.name_zh: 栗子肉桂拿铁电影海报
styles.prompt: {prompt}, 生成一幅电影海报风格的栗子肉桂拿铁宣传海报，场景设定为纯暖棕色（RGB：180,100,60）哑光背景，简洁大气。主体是透明玻璃杯装的分层栗子肉桂拿铁：底层为栗子泥（呈浓郁棕黄色，质感绵密），中层是肉桂拿铁（深棕色调，带细腻气泡），顶层覆盖杏仁奶打发奶油（蓬松柔软，表面撒满肉桂碎，颗粒感清晰）。风格参考复古电影海报与高端美食广告的融合，通过夸张文字排版和季节奖项元素，营造秋冬限定的“爆款感”。色调以暖棕色（背景）、栗子棕橙（饮品各层）、白色（奶油、文字）为主，色彩饱和度高，对比强烈。构图采用居中垂直视角**，饮品占据画面中心，文字分层环绕（上方原料说明、中间大标题、下方发售信息）。文字部分：顶部“CHESTNUT PUREE、ALMOND MILK WHIPPED CREAM、CINNAMON CRUMBS”为白色无衬线超小字体，简洁清晰；中间“栗子肉桂拿铁”为超大号白色无衬线字体（视觉冲击力强，部分叠加在奶油层下方）；大标题下方“THE CHESTNUT CINNAMON LATTE”为小号白色无衬线字体，风格复古；底部左侧发售信息“新店开业 全场八折”为白色无衬线小字体；底部右下方信息“New Arrival”为白色无衬线小字体，细节补充：奶油的蓬松纹理（每丝奶油的柔软感）、肉桂碎的颗粒反光（带细微光泽）、饮品分层的渐变过渡（栗子泥到拿铁的色彩层次）、硬阴影光影效果（增强立体感），整体传递出秋冬限定、爆款级的栗子肉桂拿铁品牌风格。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 背景为质感丝滑的深红丝绒幕布，营造复古奢华的限定氛围；构图采用多层展示架错落布局，主体是多款草莓甜品 —— 顶部是装饰金色丝带与星星的大草莓塔（堆裹饱满鲜红草莓）名字“草莓塔”，周围分布“草莓舒芙蕾”、“草莓巧克力”蛋糕（巧克力淋面搭草莓）、“草莓蛋糕杯”，每款甜品旁配对应英文 / 中文名称纤细黑体小字标签；甜品置于雕花白架、黑白展架，法式盘子等不同展示具上，散落新鲜带蒂草莓，玫瑰花，珍珠长链装饰点缀其间，搭配金色亮片褶皱布。文字部分：顶部设金色花体小字 “Love Valentine's”，下配 “莓好心动” 发光术字字体笔画融合柔美曲线与锐利直线，曲线飘逸延伸，直线挺拔利落；字形呈横向舒展且略带动态倾斜的布局，字间笔画相互呼应、富有视觉流动感；笔画粗细对比细腻（主笔稳重、辅笔纤细轻盈），线条边缘光滑自然；下方搭配纤细无衬线字体 整体营造 浪漫细腻、心动时的轻盈艺术 氛围，突出字体的曲线韵律、动态布局与中英文风格融合的效果，发光星星点缀；左侧附食材说明“选用进口丹东草莓”“选用 100% 进口动物奶油”，右侧叠加 “季节限定 WINTER” 金色椭圆标识；底部配 “—STRAWBERRY SEASON NEW PRODUCTS—” 纤细流畅英文文案。色彩以深红丝绒为基底，搭配草莓鲜红、奶油乳白、装饰金色，色调浓郁高级；画面风格是复古奢华的甜品限定风，甜品细节突出（草莓饱满泛光泽、奶油细腻绵密、巧克力淋面丝滑），既显季节限定的稀缺感，又传递精致诱人的甜品质感。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 生成一張9:16比例的專業美食攝影圖像，採用單眼相機拍攝，具大師級構圖，生動呈現「燒烤鰻魚飯」的濃郁醬香、炭火風味與豐盛滿足感。 主體呈現：一碗熱氣騰騰的燒烤鰻魚飯作為視覺核心。厚實的鰻魚段經過炭火或高溫炙烤，表面呈現深琥珀色的焦糖化光澤與清晰的網格烤痕，邊緣微焦酥脆。濃稠的日式照燒醬汁（或蒲燒醬汁）閃著油亮光澤，緊緊包裹每一塊鰻魚，並滲入下方的晶瑩白米飯中。米飯粒粒分明，飽滿油潤。頂部撒有香氣四溢的白芝麻與少許青海苔絲作為點綴。可搭配一小撮醃漬紅薑絲或山椒粉增添色彩與風味層次。 場景與構圖：採用近景特寫或微俯視角，主體盛裝於黑色或深色陶器飯碗中，以襯托鰻魚的醬色與光澤。可置於質樸的木托盤上，旁邊搭配一雙日式漆筷與一個小碟日式漬物，營造地道且誘人的日式定食氛圍。 光影與質感：採用側逆光作為主光源，精準勾勒鰻魚的立體厚度與烤痕紋理，並在醬汁表面與米飯顆粒上形成誘人的高光點。運用倫勃朗光技巧，在食材側面營造細膩的明暗過渡，突顯鰻魚的軟嫩肉質與米飯的油潤感。光線需讓醬汁呈現深邃剔透的光澤，並保持配菜的鮮活色彩。 畫面風格：整體為寫實主義風格，追求超高畫質，清晰呈現鰻魚的肌理、米飯的飽滿與醬汁的濃稠。色調以溫暖的焦糖棕、醬油黑、米白與翠綠為主，對比鮮明。畫面可營造微微熱氣升騰的動態感，彷彿能聞到炭烤香氣與照燒醬的甜鹹風味，極具視覺與味覺的雙重誘惑力。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 生成一張9:16比例的專業美食攝影圖像，採用單眼相機拍攝，具大師級構圖，呈現戰斧牛排套餐的豐盛豪邁與頂級肉食誘惑力。 主體呈現：畫面核心為一份完整的戰斧牛排套餐。巨大的戰斧牛排佔據視覺重心，表面經過高溫炙烤呈現出完美的金褐色焦化層（crust），並帶有清晰的菱形烤紋。切面展示出粉紅至玫瑰色的完美熟度，肉汁飽滿，肌理分明。骨柄部分粗壯，增添原始豪邁感。 場景與構圖：採用微俯視角，主體置於質感厚重的木質砧板或石板上，營造粗獷高級的用餐氛圍。套餐搭配需精心擺盤，可包括：裝在金屬器皿中的烤蒜、烤蔬菜（如蘆筍、小胡蘿蔔、蘑菇）、一盅濃郁的醬汁（如紅酒醬或黑胡椒醬），以及可能存在的薯條或馬鈴薯泥。構圖需平衡牛排的主體感與配菜的豐富層次。 光影與質感：採用強烈的側逆光作為主光源，精準勾勒牛排的厚實輪廓，並在焦脆表面與油潤的肉汁上形成戲劇性的高光點。運用倫勃朗光技巧，在牛排側面營造細膩的明暗過渡，突出肌理的立體感與肉質的鮮嫩多汁。光線需讓配菜色彩鮮活，醬汁呈現濃郁的光澤。 畫面風格：整體為寫實主義風格，追求超高畫質，清晰呈現牛肉的纖維、焦化層的顆粒與蔬菜的質地。色調以溫暖的金棕、焦糖色與翠綠為主，對比強烈。畫面可營造微微的熱氣感，傳遞出剛出爐的熱度、焦香與濃郁肉香，極具視覺衝擊力與奢華感。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 生成一張9:16比例的專業美食攝影圖像，採用單眼相機拍攝，具大師級構圖，生動呈現「東北燒烤」的粗獷豪邁、煙火繚繞與濃郁誘人的夜市氛圍。 主體呈現：畫面聚焦於一個熱氣蒸騰的燒烤爐或攤位上。爐架上整齊排列著各式烤串，重點包括： · 肉類：油光發亮、撒滿孜然辣椒麵的羊肉串、牛肉串，邊緣微焦捲曲的烤五花肉。 · 海鮮：色澤橙紅、蒜香撲鼻的烤扇貝與烤生蠔。 · 特色：飽滿的烤雞翅、表皮酥脆的烤雞皮、金黃的烤饅頭片。 · 蔬菜：翠綠的烤韭菜、烤金針菇、烤茄子（鋪滿蒜蓉）。 食材表面泛著誘人的油光與燒烤醬汁，孜然、辣椒等香料顆粒清晰可見。 場景與構圖：採用近景特寫或微俯視角，突出烤爐的熱氣與食物的豐盛。可將部分烤串置於質樸的不銹鋼盤或油紙上，背景可虛化處理，但隱約可見夜市燈火、冰啤酒杯或熱鬧的食客剪影，營造濃厚的市井煙火氣與熱鬧氛圍。 光影與質感：以燒烤爐的炭火紅光與夜市暖黃燈光作為主光源，營造溫暖、熱烈的基調。運用側光或逆光，精準勾勒食物冒出的縷縷煙氣與烤串的焦香質感，並在油潤表面形成高光點。光線需讓香料色彩鮮明，肉汁呈現晶瑩的光澤。 畫面風格：整體為高飽和度寫實風格，追求超高畫質，清晰呈現食材的肌理、焦化層與醬汁的濃稠。色調以熱烈的紅、棕、金黃與翠綠為主，對比強烈。畫面需強烈傳遞出炭火香氣、油脂滋啦聲與豪爽歡聚的熱烈情緒，極具視覺衝擊力與食慾誘惑力。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 创作一张榛果可可泡芙的宣传海报，背景为深棕到浅金的柔和渐变，底部为浅木色台面，整体氛围温润浓香。主体为两个榛果可可泡芙，一个完整展示外观，外壳金黄酥脆，表面轻覆可可粉与榛果碎，质地蓬松；另一个切开，露出浓郁可可榛果内馅，丝滑流动，馅料饱满香浓。周围点缀少量榛果碎与可可粉，背景光线柔和，突出烘焙质感。上方带有金色品牌标识，右侧为白色与棕金色文字“酥香浓醇 层层惊喜”，中央标题为优雅字体“榛果可可泡芙”。左侧竖排小字“酥脆外壳 榛果香浓 内馅顺滑”，底部标注产品名称“榛果可可泡芙”，并附说明小字“图片仅供参考 产品以实物为准”。整体突出泡芙的酥脆外层、榛果内馅的香气与可可层次感。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 一张极具诱惑力的黑色挞皮的蛋挞美食海报，背景为深邃的黑色到浓郁红棕色的渐变，点缀着细碎而闪烁的星光，营造出神秘而高级的宇宙感。前景中，一个完整的蛋挞放置在红棕色的细沙（有颗粒反光的效果）上，位于画面中间；另一个被切开的蛋挞（和另一个大小一致）悬浮于空中，位于另一个蛋挞上方，内馅是饱满的芝士奶盖，正呈现动态流淌的效果，具有绵密、柔滑的质感。海报上方是“芝士火星挞”的米黄色大字，使用纤细秀气的宋体，辅以流畅优雅的浅色的连笔花体英文“Custard Tart”作为点缀。它的下方是小字“焦香的黄油&配上浓郁的奶香”。底部文字呈横向排列，以 “（糯）泰国良品香稻 传统水磨工艺”“（奶）安佳动物奶油 新西兰优质奶源”“（酥）64 层法式酥皮 动物黄油开酥” 这样的分组形式，清晰对应火星挞不同部分的原料与工艺，整齐且有条理，既直观展现产品成分优势，又与上方食物主体形成呼应，方便受众快速获取关键信息。蛋挞左侧有文字“绵密奶盖 浓郁奶香”，右侧有金色的圆形徽章，上面有文字“美味 鲜品鲜售”。整体构图精致，焦点突出，采用美食摄影的打光方式，突出蛋挞的酥脆外皮与流心芝士的诱人光泽，超现实主义风格，8K分辨率。

styles.name_zh: 解构式北京烤鸭悬浮海报
styles.prompt: {prompt}, 高端中式美食海报，解构式北京烤鸭，所有元素以 45° 商业美食摄影视角 呈现，纯黑色背景，无底座、无平台，所有食材 五层结构自由漂浮。统一影棚戏剧性光线、统一材质、超逼真、高清。 Layer 1 — 荷叶饼皮 薄如蝉翼的荷叶饼轻轻漂浮，边缘微微卷起，表面略带面粉雾感，质地柔韧。 Layer 2 — 京葱丝&黄瓜条 京葱丝洁白透亮、脆口；黄瓜条翠绿饱满、带自然水光。 Layer 3 — 甜面酱光泽层 甜面酱深褐色浓稠发亮，形成半透明酱光层，流动缓慢。 Layer 4 — 烤鸭皮片 金红酥脆鸭皮，油脂形成高光反射，纹理细密逼真。 Layer 5 — 烤鸭肉片 红润多汁的鸭肉切片，肥瘦分明，肉质饱满，表面微光自然。 底层 — 完整北京烤鸭拼盘 深色陶瓷长盘中整齐陈列烤鸭皮、烤鸭肉、甜面酱、荷叶饼、京葱和黄瓜，油亮色泽，蒸汽轻柔升起。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 【影像风格与设定】 采用专业美食静物摄影技法，结合微距特写与电影级光影。画面需呈现东北炖菜的丰盛与温暖质感，强调五花肉的油润光泽、粉条的晶莹剔透与汤汁的浓郁醇厚，营造出热气腾腾、香浓扑鼻的冬日家常氛围。 【画面构图与焦点】 9:16竖幅。采用微俯视角度与浅景深构图，焦点聚焦于最上层的五花肉块与晶莹的粉条。主体盛装于厚重的陶土砂锅或深色碗中，适当露出锅边，背景为简约的木桌或厨房台面，营造朴实温暖的居家感。 【主体食物与细节】 · 核心主角：数块带皮五花肉炖煮至棕红油亮，肥肉部分呈半透明胶质感，瘦肉酥烂。土豆粉条吸饱汤汁，呈现琥珀色的半透明光泽，柔软滑糯，与肉块交织。 · 经典配菜：金黄玉米块与嫩白白菜叶清晰可见，白菜炖至半透明，边缘沾染酱色。所有食材浸润在浓稠的汤汁中，层次分明。 · 灵魂汤汁：浓郁的浅褐色汤汁微微浓稠，表面浮着一层晶莹的油花，在光线下泛出诱人光泽。汤汁需有适当的挂壁感，展现其醇厚。 【光影与色调】 采用侧后方暖色主光（约3000K），模拟厨房窗边阳光或灶台暖光，强力勾勒出五花肉的立体感与粉条、油花的高光。运用补光提亮玉米与白菜的色泽。整体色调以温暖的棕、金、琥珀色为主，突出菜品的香浓、软糯与热乎气。 【整体氛围与质感】 画面需充满刚炖好、锅气氤氲的满足感。透过对胶质、晶莹粉条、浓郁汤汁的细腻刻画，唤起观者对这道家常炖菜温暖、饱足的记忆与联想，呈现如美食纪录片般写实而诱人的高质感影像。 希望这份文案能帮助你生成满意的作品。如果需要针对其他菜式、调整光影风格或探索不同的构图视角（例如加入用餐场景或食材特写），随时可以提出。全景画面

styles.name_zh: 解构式手抓羊肉悬浮海报
styles.prompt: {prompt}, 高端中式美食海报，解构式宁夏手抓羊肉。所有元素以45°商业美食摄影视角呈现，纯黑色背景，无底座无平台，所有食材 五层自由漂浮结构。统一影棚戏剧性光线，极致写实、高清、统一材质表现。 Layer 1：粗盐&孜然粒 粗盐晶体洁白透亮，边缘锐利反光；孜然粒呈金褐色，干爽清晰，具有西北独特香气的视觉呈现。 Layer2：蒜片&香菜碎 蒜片洁白圆润，切面微透光；香菜碎翠绿清新，表面带轻微水光，形成清爽香气层。 Layer3：热汤雾层（羊汤蒸汽） 羊汤以淡乳白色薄雾形式漂浮，带轻柔油光微粒；蒸汽层形成自然弧线流动感，呈现羊肉热气腾腾的视觉氛围。Layer4：羊肉主材（大块羊排）羊排块天然红白分明，骨骼清晰、肉质厚实；表面湿润带轻油光，纤维纹理逼真，呈现宁夏盐池滩羊的肉感与质地。Layer5：辅料（胡萝卜条&土豆块）胡萝卜条橙亮饱满、土豆块淡黄湿润且切面细腻；两者带轻微汤汁光泽。 底层 完整宁夏手抓羊肉大盘 大号银盘或木盘盛装厚实大块手抓羊肉，羊排、骨段整齐堆叠；旁侧摆放胡萝卜条与土豆块，撒少量香菜与粗盐。羊肉蒸汽持续升腾，呈现西北风情的豪爽质感与纯粹肉香。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 丝网印海报，保留丝网印质感和特点，半调图案，噪点颗粒，线条简洁灵动，画面有故事感，大师级排版，极繁主义，色彩鲜明饱满。 美食杂志封面，主体是一碗冒着热气的麻辣烫（红亮的汤底泛着油花，里面堆着白嫩的豆腐泡、卷着边的肥牛、翠绿的青菜、Q弹的鱼丸，筷子夹起一片吸饱汤汁的肥牛，红油顺着筷尖滴落，香气仿佛能穿透画面）；背景是浅橙渐变底色（带砂锅的粗糙纹理），散落着手写文字：标题“CRUNCH”（字体像沸腾的气泡一样圆润，笔画间点缀着辣椒碎）、栏目“Street Hot Pot”“NUMB SPICE GUIDE”“TOFU PUFF SECRETS”“BUBBLE BROTH TRENDS”等，还有俏皮短语“SLURP THE SOUP, BLOW THE STEAM”“C'MON FISH BALL, C'MON NOODLE, INDULGE IN THE”；整体风格热辣鲜活，手绘字体与真实麻辣烫摄影相结合，满是街头小吃的热闹烟火气。 左上角小字“POSTER DESIGN” 右下角极小字“NOFUN DESIGN”

styles.name_zh: 米其林级暗调美食静物
styles.prompt: {prompt}, (((米其林級食物靜物攝影，高度寫實，奢華、極簡主義廣告風格，極致細節，攝影棚級專業打光: 5.0)))。風格融合： (((Peter Lippmann（彼得·李普曼）的戲劇性光影與質感捕捉，食物色情的慾望美學，高對比、暗調: 5.0)))。主體細節與慾望強化 (Subject Detail & Desire Enhancement)主體： 三款新品麵包（藍莓乳酪包、德式香腸包、金沙奶黃包）。質感拉爆： 極端微距特寫，高度寫實，(((強調乳酪餡爆漿的濕潤感，德式香腸表面油光誘人的光澤，金沙奶黃餡料流淌的動態與黏稠感：5.0)))，麵包外皮的酥脆紋理。陳列： 三款產品並列陳列於三塊不同的天然粗糙、深色、具有雕塑感的石塊或玄武岩板上（而非普通石塊）。光影與排版魔改 (Lighting & Typography Subversion)背景： 黑色或深灰色背景，由黃色至黃橙色的【高飽和度、極度柔和的光斑】從後方隱約漸變出來，延續高端榜單的風格。光線： 統一的極致斜側上方聚光（Spotlight），只打亮三款產品的紋理和光澤點，周圍陷入極深的陰影，營造出雕塑般的戲劇性立體感。文字：頂部大號金色襯線字體：“人氣TOP榜單 Vol.2”每個產品旁：用簡約、藝術化的排版標註“Top.5、Top.6、Top.7”及名稱價格。底部理念英文：“往來千里 自然好味”（極簡、纖細的襯線字體，精確對齊）。

styles.name_zh: 咬一口酥脆春天·天妇罗海报
styles.prompt: {prompt}, 餐饮春季菜品宣传海报，主题定为“咬一口酥脆春天”。画面以春日朦胧光晕为基调，铺陈嫩绿苔藓、细石浅滩与初生蕨叶，营造清新宁静、生机盎然的春日氛围。 画面中心是一碗丰富诱人的天妇罗盖饭，盛装于哑光黑陶碗中，质朴中透出精致。盖饭上层铺满现炸天妇罗：两尾大虾弯曲舒展，酥衣薄如轻纱，透出内里雪白虾肉；茄子切出细密纹路，裹着淡金色面衣，搭配一片片舞茸菇、芦笋尖和红薯片，每一件都保留食材本真形态。面衣蓬松酥脆，边缘泛着细密油光，表面撒着烤香的白芝麻与海苔碎。底层米饭晶莹温润，沾染浅琥珀色天妇罗酱汁，隐约映出碗沿陶器质感。 周围点缀嫩姜丝、水芹叶与柠檬角，釉色小碟中盛放橙黄蘸汁。背景虚化中可见朦胧春色、浅溪反光，光线柔和如晨雾，为整碗天妇罗镀上春日暖阳。画面写实而富有呼吸感，细腻呈现面衣纹理与食材细节，色调清新自然，层次丰富。 海报文字排版：顶部以自然笔触书写“酥物·春鲜”，右侧标注品牌英文“Spring Crispy Bowl”与标语“春日酥香 × 即刻尝鲜”，碗边配以弧形小字“一口酥脆一口春”。底部标注“精选当季食材 现炸锁鲜”，并设淡金色“春味本真 不时不食”徽章。整体氛围清新雅致、视觉诱人，传递春天现炸天妇罗的酥脆鲜美与季节限定的味觉体验。

styles.prompt: {prompt}, 主体与构图： 俯拍视角的户外野餐静物组合，构图丰富而平衡。前景核心： 一块铺在绿色草地上的米白色/浅亚麻色野餐布。布中央是一个木质托盘，盘内精心摆放着：多颗新鲜的红色草莓、一把蓝莓、几颗树莓、半个切开的牛油果、几片面包和两片柠檬。周围物品（从左到右或环绕）： 托盘旁是一杯透明玻璃杯装着的饮料，杯口插着一片柠檬和几片薄荷叶。一台复古的绿色收音机，置于托盘一侧。一个大的藤编篮子放在右侧，里面混合插着各色野花（如雏菊、小野花）并散落着一些水果。一只白色的蝴蝶正在花篮上方飞舞。一本封面素雅的书籍在托盘另一侧打开摊放。背景： 虚化的、充满光斑的绿色草地。光线与风格： 柔和明亮的自然光（如午后阳光），光影斑驳，营造出温暖、宁静、惬意的春日氛围。色彩鲜艳明快，细节丰富，景深层次感强，为高清摄影作品

styles.prompt: {prompt}, - 主体详细描述：Moebius (Jean Giraud)风格，极繁主义。非对称构图。厨房餐桌上，画面里，一张木质餐桌上摆满了丰富诱人的餐食，营造出温馨又充满食欲的氛围。 前景中，黑色的烤盘上，牛排被整齐地切成片状，表面泛着油光，带着漂亮的烤痕，色泽诱人，仿佛散发着浓郁的肉香，上面还放置着一枝翠绿的迷迭香，增添了香气与美感。旁边，金黄酥脆的薯条被装在金属网篮里，根根饱满，散发着土豆的香气。烤盘一侧，有两个金属小杯，分别装着棕色的酱汁和鲜红的番茄酱，仿佛正等待着为牛排和薯条增添风味。此外，烤盘里还有螺旋状的意面，上面覆盖着色泽诱人的酱料，旁边点缀着一颗红亮的小番茄、一朵香菇以及一些紫洋葱丝，还有翠绿的西兰花和黄色的玉米段，色彩丰富，相互映衬。 烤盘左侧的木质砧板上，放着几块烤鸡翅，鸡翅外皮金黄酥脆，仿佛散发着诱人的香气，下面垫着带有文字的纸张，为餐食增添了一份质朴的感觉。 画面上方，另一块木质托盘上，同样摆放着类似的餐食，有薯条、意面、蔬菜等，旁边还有两个金属小杯装着酱汁。右侧的蓝色碗里，装着一份色彩缤纷的沙拉，里面有翠绿的生菜、紫白相间的紫甘蓝丝、橙黄的玉米粒、鲜红的小番茄以及其他蔬菜，看起来清新又健康。 餐桌左侧，摆放着刀叉等餐具，旁边还有白色的餐巾，为用餐做好了准备。 这是一场充满生活气息的美食盛宴，各类食物色彩丰富，从牛排的棕褐、薯条的金黄，到沙拉的多彩，相互映衬，仿佛能闻到那混合着肉香、蔬菜清香、酱料香气的浓郁味道，尽显美食的诱人魅力，让人不禁心生对美食的期待与向往。场景温馨有各种厨房电器，满满一桌子食物，饱和度高，油画风格，大师杰作，笔触自然。
